Degree and approximation adverbs modify adjectives, psych-verbs, and numeric structures to calibrate intensity, comparative rank, or quantitative precision. Selection depends on syntactic positioning (pre-verbal vs. post-verbal complement), register (colloquial vs. formal), and whether the comparison is relative, absolute, or dynamic.

Adverbs of frequency and repetition occupy the pre-verbal adverbial position to define occurrence intervals, habitual tendencies, and iterative actions. Selection hinges on temporal aspect (realized past vs. projected future), empirical regularity versus absolute invariance, and pragmatic intent.

Manner and state adverbs delineate how an action is executed, characterizing personal agency, deliberate intent, interpersonal reciprocity, temporal succession, or stealth. They occupy the pre-verbal adverbial position (Adverb + Verb), qualifying the dynamics of the predicate without altering its core argument structure.

Modal, tone, and evaluation adverbs establish the speaker's epistemic commitment, subjective stance, emotional evaluation, or rhetorical orientation toward a proposition. Syntactically, they function either sententially (preceding the subject to frame the entire utterance) or pre-verbally (modifying the predicate to modulate certainty, contrast, or necessity).

Mandarin negation adverbs modulate propositional truth along two grammatical axes: aspectual realization (habitual/stative denial vs. perfective non-completion) and pragmatic force (objective refutation vs. deontic prohibition vs. epistemic reservation). Syntactically, negators occupy the immediate pre-verbal or pre-adjectival slot, strictly barring perfective aspect particles like 了 from co-occurring in the predicate.

Scope and restriction adverbs delimit the semantic domain of predicates, quantifying participant totality, imposing exclusive boundaries, or aggregating spatial and numerical breadths. Syntactically, they occupy the pre-verbal or pre-quantifier slot, frequently anchoring correlative constructions that summarize preceding subjects or conditional clauses.

Time adverbs establish temporal location relative to the moment of speech, while aspectual adverbs delineate the phase, duration, and continuity of an event. These markers precede verbs or adjectives to indicate whether an action is completed, ongoing, imminent, or progressing incrementally.

Demonstrative pronouns point to, differentiate, or categorize people, objects, locations, manners, degrees, and quantities.

Mandarin questions use in-situ word order: the sentence structure remains identical to a declarative statement—simply replace the unknown information slot with the interrogative pronoun without auxiliary verbs or inversion.

Mandarin personal pronouns are remarkably regular: they do not decline for grammatical case (there are no distinct forms for "I / me / my / mine"), and plurals are consistently formed with the suffix 们 (*men*).

Mandarin conjunctions link linguistic units—words, phrases, or full clauses—to make syntactic cohesion and logical relationships explicit. While parallel coordinators connect grammatically equal arguments, correlative subordinators operate across paired clauses to mark transition, conditionality, causality, or progression.

Directional words (方位词) function as locative nouns that attach immediately after reference nouns (Noun + Direction) without prepositions to create locative phrases, or stand independently as subjects, objects, and attributive modifiers (Direction + 的 + Noun).

Mandarin prepositions (coverbs) front a prepositional phrase before the main verb to establish the spatial, temporal, instrumental, or relational frame of an action. Unlike English prepositions, many coverbs retain verbal roots and strictly govern word order directly preceding the verb phrase.

Selection depends on syntactic positioning (pre-verbal vs. post-verbal complement), register (colloquial vs. formal), and whether the comparison is relative, absolute, or dynamic.

Usage: Unmarked, baseline intensifier placed before adjectives or psychological verbs (很 + Adj/Verb); serves as the standard structural placeholder in non-comparative descriptive predicates. Example: 那个博物馆珍藏着一件历史价值很高的青铜器。; Nàge bówùguǎn zhēncángzhe yí jiàn lìshǐ jiàzhí hěn gāo de qīngtóngqì.; That museum preserves a bronze vessel of very high historical value.

Usage: Standard high-intensity degree adverb preceding adjectives, modal verbs, or cognitive-emotional verbs (非常 + Adj/Verb); conveys greater intensity than 很. Example: 营养师推荐了一款对糖尿病患者非常有益的健康食谱。; Yíngyǎngshī tuījiànle yì kuǎn duì tángniàobìng huànzhě fēicháng yǒuyì de jiànkāng shípǔ.; The nutritionist recommended a healthy recipe that is exceptionally beneficial for diabetic patients.

Usage: Precedes predicates to express exceptional prominence or distinctive intensity; can also serve as an adjective meaning "unique". Example: 工程师研发出一种抗压性能特别优异的特种合金。; Gōngchéngshī yánfā chū yì zhǒng kàngyā xìngnéng tèbié yōuyì de tèzhǒng héjīn.; The engineers developed a special alloy with particularly outstanding compression-resistant performance.

Usage: Formal intensifier denoting a comprehensive, near-total degree (literally "ten tenths"); modifies gradable adjectives and stative verbs. Example: 答辩委员会对那篇论文所展现的缜密逻辑感到十分满意。; Dábiàn wěiyuánhuì duì nà piān lùnwén suǒ zhǎnxiàn de zhěnmì luóji gǎndào shífēn mǎnyì.; The defense committee felt extremely satisfied with the rigorous logic demonstrated in that thesis.
documents.s: 十分; shífēn; Fully / Utterly / Extremely

documents.t: Usage: Highest-tier degree marker; functions predominantly as a post-adjectival complement with 了 (Adj + 极了), or directly pre-modifies select monosyllabic adjectives in literary styles. Example: 探险队在翻越那道险关后已经疲惫极了。; Tànxiǎnduì zài fānyuè nà dào xiǎnguān hòu yǐjīng píbèi jí le.; The expedition team was exhausted to the extreme after crossing that treacherous pass.

Usage: Formal pre-verbal/pre-adjectival modifier denoting the absolute peak of an attribute (极其 + Multi-syllable Adj/Verb); strictly excluded from post-verbal complement positions. Example: 物理实验室要求研究员遵循一套极其严格的安全操作规程。; Wùlǐ shíyànshì yāoqiú yánjiūyuán zūnxún yí tào jíqí yángé de ānquán cāozuò guīchéng.; The physics laboratory requires researchers to adhere to an exceedingly strict set of safety operating procedures.

Usage: Marks an intensity that surpasses ordinary bounds, typically provoked by a specific background condition, contrast, or environmental context (格外 + Adj). Example: 金色的晨光洒在那栋历史建筑上，显得格外庄严。; Jīnsè de chénguāng sǎ zài nà dòng lìshǐ jiànzhù shàng, xiǎnde géwài zhuāngyán.; The golden morning light spilled over that historical building, appearing exceptionally solemn.

Usage: Evaluative degree adverb expressing a prominent, noteworthy level that meets or exceeds expectations (相当 + Adj/Verb). Example: 银行审批这笔巨额商业贷款的流程相当复杂。; Yínháng shěnpī zhè bǐ jù'é shāngyè dàikuǎn de liúchéng xiāngdāng fùzá.; The bank's approval process for this substantial commercial loan is considerably complex.

Usage: Expresses an excessive degree that breaches an acceptable limit (太 + Adj/Verb), or conveys emphatic praise in exclamatory constructions (太 + Adj + 了). Example: 那个剧团今晚演出的这出舞台剧太震撼了。; Nàge jùtuán jīnwǎn yǎnchū de zhè chū wǔtáijù tài zhènhàn le.; This stage play performed by that theatrical troupe tonight was breathtakingly astounding.

Usage: Colloquial and spoken intensifier conveying an approving or casual tone; typically frames adjectives alongside modal particle 的 (挺 + Adj + 的). Example: 旅行社在景区为游客安排的那间客房挺宽敞的。; Lǚxíngshè zài jǐngqū wèi yóukè ānpái de nà jiān kèfáng tǐng kuānchǎng de.; That guest room arranged by the travel agency for tourists in the scenic area is quite spacious.

Usage: Emphatic, emotive adverb used in affirmative assertions and direct observations (真 + Adj/Verb); expresses sincere conviction, subjective appraisal, or exclamatory surprise. Example: 老裁缝手工缝制的这件旗袍剪裁真精致！; Lǎo cáifeng shǒugōng féngzhì de zhè jiàn qípáo jiǎncái zhēn jīngzhì!; The tailoring on this cheongsam hand-sewn by the master tailor is truly exquisite!

Usage: Relative degree adverb indicating escalation on top of an existing baseline; used in comparative sentences (比...更...) or implicit comparative contexts. Example: 新提出的这套节能方案比原计划更能节省开支。; Xīn tíchū de zhè tào jiénéng fāng'àn bǐ yuán jìhuà gèng néng jiéshěng kāizhī.; This newly proposed energy-saving scheme can cut expenses even more than the original plan.

Usage: Formal, multi-syllable equivalent of 更; primarily modifies two-syllable adjectives and complex verbal constructions to signify amplified progression. Example: 政府颁布的这项新法规让企业减排的标准更加明确。; Zhèngfǔ bānbù de zhè xiàng xīn fǎguī ràng qǐyè jiǎnpái de biāozhǔn gèngjiā míngquè.; This new regulation promulgated by the government makes emission reduction standards for enterprises even more explicit.
documents.s: 更加; gèngjiā; Even more / Still more

documents.t: Usage: Superlative degree adverb expressing the supreme or terminal point within a referenced comparative set (最 + Adj/Verb). Example: 这座国际机场是全国起降货运航班最繁忙的枢纽。; Zhè zuò guójì jīchǎng shì quánguó qǐjiàng huòyùn hángbān zuì fánmáng de shūniǔ.; This international airport is the most active hub in the entire country for landing and departing cargo flights.

Usage: Attenuates assertions by marking moderate comparative intensity ("fairly / relatively"); modifies adjectives and stative verbs without needing a direct comparator. Example: 技术人员建议挑选那款性能比较稳定的操作系统。; Jìshù rényuán jiànyì tiāoxuǎn nà kuǎn xìngnéng bǐjiào wěndìng de cāozuò xìtǒng.; Technicians suggest selecting that operating system with relatively stable performance.

Usage: Singling-out adverb that isolates a specific item within a broader class to show a heightened degree; regularly paired with copula 是 (尤其/特别是 + Focal Element). Example: 展厅里陈列的现代艺术品吸引了大量观众，尤其是那一幅抽象油画。; Zhǎntīng lǐ chénliè de xiàndài yìshùpǐn xīyǐnle dàliàng guānzhòng, yóuqí shì nà yì fú chōuxiàng yóuhuà.; The modern artworks displayed in the exhibition hall attracted vast audiences, especially that abstract oil painting.

Usage: Designates minimal degree or slight adjustment; commonly coordinates with post-adjectival diminutive markers (稍微 + Adj/Verb + 一点儿 / 一些). Example: 调琴师把那根琴弦稍微调紧了一点儿。; Tiáoqínshī bǎ nà gēn qínxián shāowēi tiáojǐn le yìdiǎnr.; The piano tuner tightened that musical string slightly.
documents.s: 稍微; shāowēi; Slightly / A little bit

documents.t: Usage: Written, progressive adverb meaning "more with each passing day"; exclusively modifies dynamic gradable adjectives and trend-oriented verbs (日益 + Adj/Verb). Example: 跨国制造企业必须面对一场日益激烈的全球人才竞争。; Kuàguó zhìzào qǐyè bìxū miànduì yì chǎng rìyì jīliè de quánqiú réncái jìngzhēng.; Multinational manufacturing enterprises must confront an increasingly fierce global talent competition.
documents.s: 日益; rìyì; Day by day / Increasingly

documents.t: Usage: Correlative progressive marker indicating scalar increase proportionally tied to time or conditions (越 A 越 B, or temporally anchored 越来越 + Adj). Example: 登山队员越接近那座雪山的山顶，空气就越稀薄。; Dēngshānduìyuán yuè jiējìn nà zuò xuěshān de shāndǐng, kōngqì jiù yuè xībó.; The closer the mountaineers got to the summit of that snow mountain, the thinner the air became.

Usage: Literary variant of 更加/越来越, signaling intensified internal reactions or deepening conditions sparked by a specific development (越发 + Adj/Verb). Example: 听完那位负责人的这番辩解，调查人员的心中越发感到困惑。; Tīngwán nà wèi fùzérén de zhè fān biànjiě, diàochá rényuán de xīnzhōng yuèfā gǎndào kùnhuò.; After listening to this justification from that person in charge, the investigators felt all the more perplexed.
documents.s: 越发; yuèfā; All the more / Increasingly

documents.t: Usage: Denotes close approximation to a critical threshold, total state, or absolute limit without reaching it (几乎 + Verb/Adj/Quantifier); focuses on proximity to a whole. Example: 昨晚席卷沿海的那场强台风几乎摧毁了整座果园。; Zuówǎn xíjuǎn yánhǎi de nà chǎng qiáng táifēng jīhū cuīhuǐle zhěng zuò guǒyuán.; That severe typhoon that swept the coast last night almost destroyed the entire orchard.

Usage: Flexible approximation marker; operates as a pre-predicate adverb ("nearly"), a predicative adjective ("comparable / almost alike"), or modifies numerical amounts. Example: 翻译团队历时三年，差不多完成了那部哲学巨著的中文译稿。; Fānyì tuánduì lìshí sān nián, chàbuduō wánchéngle nà bù zhéxué jùzhù de zhōngwén yìgǎo.; Spending three years, the translation team has almost completed the Chinese draft of that monumental philosophical work.
documents.s: 差不多; chàbuduō; Almost / About the same

documents.t: Usage: Objective approximation adverb used explicitly with quantities, numerical estimates, or factual intervals (大约 + Numeral-Classifier Phrase). Example: 那艘满载矿石的货轮大约需要航行四十五天才能抵达目的港。; Nà sōu mǎnzǎi kuàngshí de huòlún dàyuē xūyào hángxíng sìshíwǔ tiān cái néng dǐdá mùdìgǎng. ; That freighter fully loaded with ore needs to sail for approximately forty-five days to arrive at the destination port.

Usage: Expresses either numerical approximation or epistemic conjecture ("most likely / presumably"); possesses broader subjective probability than purely factual 大约. Example: 药剂师估算调制这一剂传统汤药大概需要耗费两百元。; Yàojìshī gūsuàn tiáozhì zhè jì chuántǒng tāngyào dàgài xūyào hàofèi liǎngbǎi yuán.; The pharmacist estimated that preparing this dose of traditional medicinal broth would probably cost two hundred yuan.

Usage: Emphatic exclamatory adverb placed immediately before adjectives or psychological verbs to indicate heightened subjective sentiment (多么 + Adj/Verb (+ 啊)!); restricted to exclamative syntax. Example: 能亲身参与并见证这一段伟大的历史是多么令人自豪的体验啊！; Néng qīnshēn cānyù bìng jiànzhèng zhè yí duàn wěidà de lìshǐ shì duōme lìngrén zìháo de tǐyàn a!; What a proud experience it is to personally participate in and witness this great period of history!
documents.s: 多么; duōme; How / What (an intense...)

documents.t: Adverbs of frequency and repetition occupy the pre-verbal adverbial position to define occurrence intervals, habitual tendencies, and iterative actions. Selection hinges on temporal aspect (realized past vs. projected future), empirical regularity versus absolute invariance, and pragmatic intent.

Usage: Placed before verbs or adjectives to denote an unchanging, persistent state or universal occurrence across all relevant scenarios (总是 + Verb/Adj). Example: 这趟航班总是因为恶劣的天气延误。; Zhè tàng hángbān zǒngshì yīnwèi èliè de tiānqì yánwù.; This flight is always delayed due to severe weather.

Usage: Modifies actions with high recurring frequency; can be directly negated by 不 to indicate infrequency (不经常), and can function as an attributive adjective modifying nouns. Example: 这位律师经常处理一宗复杂的商业诉讼。; Zhè wèi lǜshī jīngcháng chǔlǐ yì zōng fùzá de shāngyè sùsòng.; This lawyer frequently handles complex commercial lawsuits.

Usage: Pre-verbal frequency adverb indicating habitual recurrence; cannot be modified by 不 (negated via 不常), cannot modify nouns, and focuses on routine actions. Example: 建筑师常常加班修改一张关键的设计图纸。; Jiànzhùshī chángcháng jiābān xiūgǎi yì zhāng guānjiàn de shèjì túzhǐ.; Architects often work overtime to revise a crucial design drawing.

Usage: Highlights an empirical regularity, predictable outcome, or natural tendency under specific conditions; requires a prerequisite context or conditional clause. Example: 缺乏沟通的团队往往会引发一场严重的信任危机。; Quēfá gōutōng de tuánduì wǎngwǎng huì yǐnfā yì chǎng yánzhòng de xìnrèn wēijī.; Teams lacking communication often trigger a severe crisis of trust.
documents.s: 往往; wǎngwǎng; Often / As a rule

documents.t: Usage: Marks general conventions, standard operating procedures, or baseline conditions; can occupy sentence-initial position or function as a noun-modifier. Example: 大使馆通常需要两周时间审批一份签证申请。; Dàshǐguǎn tōngcháng xūyào liǎng zhōu shíjiān shěnpī yí fèn qiānzhèng shēnqǐng.; The embassy usually takes two weeks to process a visa application.

Usage: Signals low, non-systematic occurrence frequency; acts as the direct antonym of 经常 (偶尔 + Verb). Example: 这位外科医生偶尔会弹奏一架古老的钢琴来缓解压力。; Zhè wèi wàikē yīshēng ǒu'ěr huì tánzòu yí jià gǔlǎo de gāngqín lái huǎnjiě yālì.; The surgeon occasionally plays an antique piano to relieve stress.
documents.s: 偶尔; ǒu'ěr; Occasionally / Once in a while

documents.t: Usage: Denotes absolute continuity from past to present; predominantly coupled with negative particles 不 (habitual refusal: 从来不) or 没 (lack of experiential occurrence: 从来没). Example: 这家谨慎的企业从来不参与任何一项高风险的投机交易。; Zhè jiā jǐnshèn de qǐyè cónglái bù cānyù rènhé yí xiàng gāo-fēngxiǎn de tóujī jiāoyì.; This prudent enterprise never engages in any high-risk speculative transactions.
documents.s: 从来; cónglái; Always / Never (with negative)

documents.t: Usage: Specifies an unbroken temporal span or sustained action without interruption (一直 + Verb/Predicate). Example: 监督员一直密切监测那座钢铁厂的污水排放指标。; Jiāndūyuán yìzhí mìqiè jiāncè nà zuò gāngtiěchǎng de wūshuǐ páifàng zhǐbiāo.; Inspectors have consistently and closely monitored the wastewater emission metrics of that steel plant.
documents.s: 一直; yìzhí; Continuously / All along

documents.t: Usage: Formal adverb indicating persistent adherence to an orientation, principle, or factual truth across an entire duration despite external shifts. Example: 那个科研团队在实验中始终保持着一种严谨的治学态度。; Nàge kēyán tuánduì zài shíyàn zhōng shǐzhōng bǎochízhe yì zhǒng yánjǐn de zhìxué tàidu.; The research team maintained a rigorous scholarly attitude throughout their experiments.
documents.s: 始终; shǐzhōng; From beginning to end / Throughout

documents.t: Usage: Marks the recurrence of an event that has already taken place (past/factual), or cyclical actions occurring by regular schedule. Example: 这个苹果又大又甜。; Zhè ge píngguǒ yòu dà yòu tián.;This apple is both big and sweet

Usage: Directs repetition toward future, unfulfilled, or prospective events; commonly marks sequential completion (先...再...). Example: 委员会建议他先补充一份财务证明，然后再递交申请表。; Wěiyuánhuì jiànyì tā xiān bǔchōng yí fèn cáiwù zhèngmíng, ránhòu zài dìjiāo shēnqǐngbiǎo.; The committee suggested that he supplement a financial certificate first before submitting the application form.

Usage: Denotes initiating an operation from the beginning, typically to revise, correct, or adjust previous unsatisfactory outcomes (重新 + Verb). Example: 董事会要求专家组重新评估那一套投资方案的可行性。; Dǒngshìhuì yāoqiú zhuānjiāzǔ chóngxīn pínggū nà yí tào tóuzī fāng'àn de kěxíngxìng.; The board of directors requested the expert group to re-evaluate the feasibility of that investment scheme.
documents.s: 重新; chóngxīn; Anew / Again from the start

documents.t: Usage: Highlights cyclical iterations, back-and-forth behavioral processes, or exhaustive deliberation before reaching a conclusion (反复 + Verb). Example: 发言人反复推敲了一篇外交演讲稿中的用词细节。; Fāyánrén fǎnfù tuīqiāo le yì piān wàijiāo yǎnjiǎnggǎo zhōng de yòngcí xìjié.; The spokesperson repeatedly scrutinized the wording details in a diplomatic speech draft.
documents.s: 反复; fǎnfù; Repeatedly / Over and over

documents.t: Usage: Emphasizes high-stakes deliberate intent, urging, or consideration; restricted almost exclusively to communicative, cognitive, or intentional verbs (再三考虑, 再三叮嘱). Example: 经理再三叮嘱出纳员务必妥善保管那一枚公章。; Jīnglǐ zàisān dīngzhǔ chūnàyuán wùbì tuǒshàn bǎoguǎn nà yì méi gōngzhāng.; The manager repeatedly instructed the cashier to properly safe-keep that official seal.
documents.s: 再三; zàisān; Over and over / Repeatedly

documents.t: Usage: Stresses ongoing reiteration of an action, particularly in contexts where advice is unheeded or where an undesirable situation is repeatedly delayed or ignored. Example: 组委会因为突发情况一再推迟了那一届博览会的开幕日期。; Zǔwěihuì yīnwèi tūfā qíngkuàng yízài tuīchí le nà yí jiè bólǎnhuì de kāimù rìqī.; Due to unexpected circumstances, the organizing committee repeatedly postponed the opening date of that expo.
documents.s: 一再; yízài; Repeatedly / Time and again

documents.t: Usage: Formal adverb indicating repeated occurrences of an event, commonly applied to infractions, regulatory violations, or uncorrected errors. Example: 那个司机屡次违反交通信号灯，最终被吊销了一本驾驶证。; Nàge sījī lǚcì wéifǎn jiāotōng xìnhàodēng, zuìzhōng bèi diàoxiāo le yì běn jiàshǐzhèng.; That driver repeatedly violated traffic lights and ultimately had his driver's license revoked.
documents.s: 屡次; lǚcì; Time and again / Repeatedly

documents.t: Manner and state adverbs delineate how an action is executed, characterizing personal agency, deliberate intent, interpersonal reciprocity, temporal succession, or stealth. They occupy the pre-verbal adverbial position (Adverb + Verb), qualifying the dynamics of the predicate without altering its core argument structure.

Usage: Modifies actions executed with conscious premeditation, often carrying a negative pragmatic nuance of provocation, concealment, or calculated rule-breaking (故意 + Verb). Example: 证人在法庭上故意隐瞒了一条能够证明被告清白的关键线索。; Zhèngrén zài fǎtíng shàng gùyì yǐnmánle yì tiáo nénggòu zhèngmíng bèigào qīngbái de guānjiàn xiànsuǒ.; The witness deliberately concealed a critical clue in court that could prove the defendant's innocence.
documents.s: 故意; gùyì; Deliberately / On purpose

documents.t: Usage: Highlights dedicated effort, special thoughtfulness, or targeted accommodation made specifically for a positive or courteous purpose (特意 + 为/给... + Verb). Example: 老教授特意为毕业典礼挑选了一套饱含学术传承的珍贵古籍。; Lǎo jiàoshòu tèyì wèi bìyè diǎnlǐ tiāoxuǎnle yí tào bǎohán xuéshù chuánchéng de zhēnguì gǔjí.; The old professor specially selected a set of precious ancient classics imbued with scholarly heritage for the graduation ceremony.

Usage: Indicates operational specialization, dedicated task assignment, or institutional purpose; functions both as a pre-verbal adverb (专门 + Verb) and as an attributive adjective modifying nouns (专门人才). Example: 卫生部门专门设立了一所装备先进的康复中心来照料伤残退伍军人。; Wèishēng bùmén zhuānmén shèlìle yì suǒ zhuāngbèi xiānjìn de kāngfù zhōngxīn lái zhàoliào shāngcán tuìwǔ jūnrén.; The health department specially established a rehabilitation center with advanced equipment to care for disabled veterans.

Usage: Characterizes actions performed casually, without due reflection or resistance; overwhelmingly negated (不轻易 / 切勿轻易) to signal prudent restraint. Example: 资深投资人绝不会因为短期市场波动就轻易抛售手头那批优质股票。; Zīshēn tóuzīrén jué bú huì yīnwèi duǎnqī shìchǎng bōdòng jiù qīngyì pāoshòu shǒutóu nà pī yōuzhì gǔpiào.; Experienced investors will by no means rashly sell off that batch of high-quality shares in their hands due to short-term market fluctuations.
documents.s: 轻易; qīngyì; Lightly / Rashly / Easily

documents.t: Usage: Indicates that a secondary, incidental action is accomplished along the trajectory of a primary errand without incurring extra effort or travel (顺便 + Verb). Example: 秘书去市政厅办事时，顺便投递了一封加急的商务邀请函。; Mìshū qù shìzhèngtīng bànshì shí, shùnbiàn tóudìle yì fēng jiājí de shāngwù yāoqǐnghán.; While running errands at City Hall, the secretary conveniently delivered an urgent commercial invitation letter in passing.
documents.s: 顺便; shùnbiàn; In passing / Conveniently

documents.t: Usage: Emphasizes first-hand involvement, on-site presence, or personal leadership by a person of status, ruling out surrogates or subordinates (亲自 + Verb). Example: 总建筑师冒着严寒亲自视察了那一处位于悬崖边缘的施工工地。; Zǒng jiànzhùshī màozhe yánhán qīnzì shìchále nà yí chù wèiyú xuányá biānyuán de shīgōng gōngdì.; Braving the severe cold, the chief architect personally inspected that construction site perched on the edge of the cliff.
documents.s: 亲自; qīnzì; In person / Personally

documents.t: Usage: Specifies an individual action conducted in isolation without companions, external assistance, or collaborative supervision (单独 + Verb). Example: 经过严格考核，那位飞行学员终于获准单独驾驶一架轻型教练机。; Jīngguò yángé kǎohé, nà wèi fēixíng xuéyuán zhōngyú huòzhǔn dāndú jiàshǐ yí jià qīngxíng jiàoliànjī.; After rigorous assessment, that flight trainee was finally permitted to fly a light trainer aircraft alone.
documents.s: 单独; dāndú; Alone / By oneself / Independently

documents.t: Usage: Depicts physical actions carried out with minimal sound or overt motion to avoid detection or prevent disturbing others (悄悄 + Motion/Physical Verb). Example: 值班护士替病人掖好被角，然后悄悄关上了那扇沉重的病房木门。; Zhíbān hùshi tì bìngrén yē hǎo bèijiǎo, ránhòu qiāoqiāo guānshàngle nà shàn chénzhòng de bìngfáng mùmén.; The nurse on duty tucked the patient in, then quietly closed that heavy wooden ward door.

Usage: Characterizes unexpressed internal reflections, hidden emotional currents, or private determinations kept strictly inside one's thoughts (暗暗 + Cognitive/Psych Verb). Example: 青年学者在心里暗暗下定决心，一定要攻克这一道困扰学界多年的几何难题。; Qīngnián xuézhě zài xīnli àn'àn xiàdìng juéxīn, yídìng yào gōngkè zhè yí dào kùnrǎo xuéjiè duō nián de jǐhé nántí.; The young scholar secretly resolved in his mind that he must conquer this geometry conundrum that has troubled academia for years.
documents.s: 暗暗; àn'àn; Inwardly / Secretly to oneself

documents.t: Usage: Pre-verbal reciprocal adverb signaling two-way interactive feedback between plural subjects; directly precedes transitive action verbs (互相 + Verb); cannot be modified by degree adverbs. Example: 两家新兴科技企业在市场竞争中互相借鉴了一套高效的管理经验。; Liǎng jiā xīnxīng kējì qǐyè zài shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng hùxiāng jièjiànle yí tào gāoxiào de guǎnlǐ jīngyàn.; The two emerging technology companies mutually borrowed an efficient set of management experiences amidst market competition.
documents.s: 互相; hùxiāng; Mutually / Each other

documents.t: Usage: Formal reciprocal marker functioning flexibly as a pre-verbal adverb (相互支持), an attributive noun modifier (相互关系), or an abstract relational noun. Example: 两国边界部队依据那份防务条约相互通报了近期的巡逻动态。; Liǎng guó biānjiè bùduì yījù nà fèn fángwù tiáoyuē xiānghù tōngbàole jìnqī de xúnduó dòngtài.; The border forces of both nations mutually briefed each other on recent patrol developments in accordance with that defense treaty.

Usage: Standard connective adverb indicating joint spatial co-presence or simultaneous collaborative effort (A 与/跟 B 一起 + Verb). Example: 青年学者同几位资深勘探队员一起绘制了一幅精密的地层剖面图。; Qīngnián xuézhě tóng jǐ wèi zīshēn kāntàn duìyuán yìqǐ huìzhìle yì fú jīngmì de dìcéng pōumiàntú.; The young scholar, together with several veteran prospectors, plotted a precise geological cross-section diagram.
documents.s: 一起; yìqǐ; Together / In company

documents.t: Usage: Formal and literary counterpart of 一起; predominantly employed in ceremonial, diplomatic, or institutional accounts depicting joint participation. Example: 文化部长与外国使节一同出席了那一套珍稀非遗织锦的捐赠仪式。; Wénhuà bùzhǎng yǔ wàiguó shǐjié yìtóng chūxíle nà yí tào zhēnxī fēiyí zhījǐn de juānzèng yíshì.; The Minister of Culture, together with foreign envoys, attended the donation ceremony for that set of rare intangible heritage brocades.
documents.s: 一同; yìtóng; Together / In company with

documents.t: Usage: Descriptive plural manner adverb depicting numerous diverse actors taking action in rapid, spontaneous succession or widespread wave-like concurrence (Plural Subject + 纷纷 + Verb). Example: 灾情发生后，沿海市民纷纷向慈善机构捐献了一批急需的御寒衣物。; Zāiqíng fāshēng hòu, yánhǎi shìmín fēnfēn xiàng císhàn jīgòu juānxiànle yì pī jíxū de yùhán yīwù.; After the disaster occurred, coastal citizens one after another donated a batch of urgently needed cold-weather clothing to charity organizations.
documents.s: 纷纷; fēnfēn; One after another / In succession

documents.t: Usage: Objective sequential adverb denoting an orderly, staged continuation where entities arrive or actions transpire intermittently across a timeline (陆续 + Verb). Example: 各国代表团在清晨陆续登上了那艘停泊在港湾内的科考母船。; Gè guó dàibiǎotuán zài qīngchén lùxù dēngshàngle nà sōu tíngbó zài gǎngwān nèi de kěkǎo mǔchuán.; The delegations of various countries stepped one after another in succession onto that scientific research mothership moored in the harbor at dawn.
documents.s: 陆续; lùxù; Successively / One after another

documents.t: Usage: Denotes that an action or operational routine persists strictly according to standard precedent, completely undeterred by altered conditions, interference, or hazards (照样 + Verb). Example: 尽管外头暴雨倾盆，老邮递员照样按时将那一捆报纸送达了深山哨所。; Jǐnguǎn wàitou bàoyǔ qīngpén, lǎo yóudìyuán zhàoyàng ànshí jiāng nà yì kǔn bàozhǐ sòngdá le shēnshān shàosuǒ.; Even though torrential rain poured outside, the veteran postman delivered that bundle of newspapers to the deep-mountain outpost on schedule all the same.
documents.s: 照样; zhàoyàng; Still / As usual / All the same

documents.t: Modal, tone, and evaluation adverbs establish the speaker's epistemic commitment, subjective stance, emotional evaluation, or rhetorical orientation toward a proposition. Syntactically, they function either sententially (preceding the subject to frame the entire utterance) or pre-verbally (modifying the predicate to modulate certainty, contrast, or necessity).

Usage: Confirms the indisputable truth, authenticity, or factual basis of a situation (确实 + Verb/Adj). Example: 这部纪录片确实揭露了当年那场金融危机背后的制度漏洞。; Zhè bù jìlùpiàn quèshí jiēlùle dāngnián nà chǎng jīnróng wēijī bèihòu de zhìdù lòudòng.; This documentary film indeed exposed the institutional loopholes behind that financial crisis of that year.
documents.s: 确实; quèshí; Indeed / Truly / Reliably

documents.t: Usage: Clarifies underlying objective reality, correcting a false impression, surface assumption, or misconception (其实 + Clause/Predicate). Example: 双方代表其实早已就那份补充协议的核心条款达成了共识。; Shuāngfāng dàibiǎo qíshí zǎoyǐ jiù nà fèn bǔchōng xiéyì de héxīn tiáokuǎn dáchéngle gòngshí.; Both delegations had actually reached a consensus on the core terms of that supplemental agreement long ago.
documents.s: 其实; qíshí; Actually / In fact

documents.t: Usage: Marks an inference or conclusion as self-evident and readily discernible from observable facts (显然 + Predicate/Clause). Example: 这份审计报告显然证明管理层故意隐瞒了上个季度的巨额亏损。; Zhè fèn shěnjì bàogào xiǎnrán zhèngmíng guǎnlǐcéng gùyì yǐnmánle shàng gè jìdù de jù'é kuīsǔn.; This audit report evidently proves that management intentionally concealed the massive losses of the previous quarter.

Usage: Expresses that an outcome follows logically, organically, and inevitably from precedent conditions (自然 + Verb/Predicate). Example: 研发团队成功斩获这项国际专利后，自然会吸引来众多风投资金。; Yánfā tuánduì chénggōng zhǎnhuò zhè xiàng guójì zhuānlì hòu, zìrán huì xīyǐn lái zhòngduō fēngtóu zījīn.; After the R&D team successfully clinched this international patent, it naturally attracted substantial venture capital funds.
documents.s: 自然; zìrán; Naturally / As a matter of course

documents.t: Usage: Emphasizes that an assertion is beyond dispute or logically unquestionable; can also concede a secondary point (当然，...但是...). Example: 作为一位资深的辩护律师，他当然要全力维护当事人的合法权益。; Zuòwéi yí wèi zīshēn de biànhù lǜshī, tā dāngrán yào quánlì wéihù dāngshìrén de héfǎ quányì.; As a veteran defense attorney, he of course must defend the lawful rights of his client with all his might.
documents.s: 当然; dāngrán; Of course / Certainly

documents.t: Usage: Confirms that a preceding prediction, forecast, or apprehension has been fulfilled by reality (果然 + Verb/Predicate). Example: 气象台预报的那场特大暴风雪，今天清晨果然导致了全城交通瘫痪。; Qìxiàngtái yùbào de nà chǎng tèdà bàofēngxuě, jīntiān qīngchén guǒrán dǎozhìle quánchéng jiāotōng tānhuàn.; That severe blizzard forecast by the meteorological station sure enough caused city-wide traffic paralysis this morning.
documents.s: 果然; guǒrán; Sure enough / As expected

documents.t: Usage: Contrasts a past baseline, initial intention, or intrinsic property with an altered reality (本来 + Predicate/Clause). Example: 旅客们本来预订了这趟直飞航班，却因机械故障不得不更改行程。; Lǚkèmén běnlái yùdìngle zhè tàng zhífēi hángbān, què yīn jīxiè gùzhàng bùdébù gēnggǎi xíngchéng.; The passengers had originally booked this direct flight, but were compelled to change itineraries due to a mechanical malfunction.
documents.s: 本来; běnlái; Originally / By nature

documents.t: Usage: Expresses tentative conjecture, low-to-moderate probability, or polite non-committal speculation (也许 + Verb/Clause). Example: 这一剂改良的中药方剂也许能够彻底缓解困扰他多年的慢性胃炎。; Zhè jì gǎiliáng de zhōngyào fāngjì yěxǔ nénggòu chèdǐ huǎnjiě kùnrǎo tā duō nián de mànxìng wèiyán.; This modified dose of herbal medicine perhaps can completely alleviate the chronic gastritis that has plagued him for years.

Usage: Denotes a high probability based on general estimates, empirical likelihood, or approximate judgment (大概 + Predicate). Example: 考古学家推断这批出土的青铜器皿大概制作于西周早期。; Kǎogǔxuéjiā tuīduàn zhè pī chūtǔ de qīngtóng qìmǐn dàgài zhìzuò yú Xīzhōu zǎoqī.; Archaeologists infer that this batch of unearthed bronze vessels was likely fabricated during the early Western Zhou period.

Usage: Sentential evidential adverb signaling an inductive deduction derived from circumstantial evidence or visible patterns (看来 + Clause). Example: 防汛指挥部看来需要重新启动那套针对突发山洪的紧急疏散预案。; Fángxùn zhǐhuībù kànlai xūyào chóngxīn qǐdòng nà tào zhēnduì tūfā shānhóng de jǐnjí shūsàn yù'àn.; The flood prevention headquarters apparently needs to reboot that emergency evacuation protocol targeting flash floods.
documents.s: 看来; kànlai; Apparently / It seems

documents.t: Usage: Softens a categorical assertion or expresses polite skepticism regarding an alleged certainty (不见得 + Adj/Verb). Example: 驾驶一辆价值不菲的豪华跑车不见得就能带来真正的内心充实。; Jiàshǐ yí liàng jiàzhí bùfěi de háohuá pǎochē bújiànde jiù néng dàilái zhēnzhèng de nèixīn chōngshí.; Driving a high-value luxury sports car does not necessarily bring genuine internal fulfillment.
documents.s: 不见得; bújiànde; Not necessarily / Unlikely

documents.t: Usage: Indicates sudden realization of why an anomaly occurred once the underlying cause or condition is revealed (难怪 + Clause). Example: 他每天在泳池里高强度训练十个小时，难怪能摘得这枚奥运金牌。; Tā měitiān zài yǒngchí lǐ gāo-qiángdù xùnliàn shí gè xiǎoshí, nánguài néng zhāidé zhè méi Àoyùn jīnpái.; He trains with high intensity in the pool ten hours daily; no wonder he was able to capture this Olympic gold medal.
documents.s: 难怪; nánguài; No wonder / Understandably

documents.t: Usage: Deontic modal adverb signaling mandatory operational requirement, legal compulsion, or absolute necessity (必须 + Verb). Example: 所有新入职的核心工程师都必须签署一份严格的技术保密协议。; Suǒyǒu xīn rùzhí de héxīn gōngchéngshī dōu bìxū qiānshǔ yí fèn yángé de jìshù bǎomì xiéyì.; All newly recruited core engineers must sign a strict technical confidentiality agreement.

Usage: Formal imperative adverb indicating urgent admonition, strict managerial decree, or non-negotiable instruction (务必 + Verb). Example: 离开办公室前请务必把那叠机密图纸锁入保险柜中。; Líkāi bàngōngshì qián qǐng wùbì bǎ nà dié jīmì túzhǐ suǒrù bǎoxiǎnguì zhōng.; Before departing the office, please be sure to lock that stack of classified blueprints into the safe.
documents.s: 务必; wùbì; Be sure to / By all means

documents.t: Usage: Emphatic cautionary adverb used to plead, warn, or prohibit, heavily concentrated in negative commands (千万别... / 千万不可...). Example: 施工人员在挖掘作业时千万不可触碰地下那根高压电缆。; Shīgōng rényuán zài wājué zuòyè shí qiānwàn bùkě chùpèng dìxià nà gēn gāoyā diànlǎn.; Construction personnel must under no circumstances disturb that high-voltage underground cable during excavation work.
documents.s: 千万; qiānwàn; Above all / By all means

documents.t: Usage: Expresses strong personal resolve ("definitely will"), firm epistemic certainty ("bound to"), or assertive instruction (一定 + Verb/Adj). Example: 建设兵团下定决心在年底前一定要让那座大型水电站顺利并网发电。; Jiànshè bīngtuán xiàdìng juéxīn zài niándǐ qián yídìng yào ràng nà zuò dàxíng shuǐdiànzhàn shùnlì bìngwǎng fādiàn.; The construction corps made up its mind that it must connect that large hydroelectric station to the power grid by year-end.

Usage: Diplomatic, constructive suggestion marker proposing an alternative path of action without imposing pressure (不妨 + Verb). Example: 如果您经常需要在嘈杂环境中办公，不妨试戴一下这款无线降噪耳机。; Rúguǒ nín jīngcháng xūyào zài cáozá huánjìng zhōng bàngōng, bùfáng shìdài yíxià zhè kuǎn wúxiàn jiàngzào ěrjī.; If you frequently need to work in noisy environments, there is no harm in trying on this wireless noise-cancelling headset.
documents.s: 不妨; bùfáng; Might as well / There is no harm in

documents.t: Usage: Deepens an interrogation, probing for ultimate bottom-line truth in questions (究竟 + Wh-word/V-not-V); formal equivalent of 到底. Example: 历史学家们试图弄清楚这桩尘封半个世纪的悬案究竟隐藏了什么内幕。; Lìshǐxuéjiāmén shìtú nòng qīngchu zhè zhuāng chénfēng bàn gè shìjì de xuán'àn jiūjìng yǐncángle shénme nèimù.; Historians are striving to clarify what inside secrets this unsettled case shelved for half a century actually hides.
documents.s: 究竟; jiūjìng; Exactly / In the final analysis

documents.t: Usage: Presses for an explicit, definitive resolution in interrogatives, or marks an ultimate realization after prolonged delays. Example: 工程师花了整整三天排查，也没查出这台激光雕刻机到底出了什么故障。; Gōngchéngshī huāle zhěngzhěng sān tiān páichá, yě méi cháchū zhè tái jīguāng diāokèjī dàodǐ chūle shénme gùzhàng.; The engineer spent three full days troubleshooting and still could not figure out what on earth went wrong with this laser engraver.
documents.s: 到底; dàodǐ; On earth / Down to the root

documents.t: Usage: Signals a rhetorical question that challenges an absurd proposition, expecting a vigorous negative assent (难道...吗/不成?). Example: 难道企业花费重金打造的这道网络防火墙连一个初级黑客都防不住吗？; Nándào qǐyè huāfèi zhòngjīn dǎzào de zhè dào wǎngluò fánghuǒqiáng lián yí gè chūjí hēikè dōu fáng bú zhù ma?; Could it be that this network firewall the enterprise spent a fortune building cannot even defend against an entry-level hacker?
documents.s: 难道; nándào; Could it be that...? / Don't tell me...

documents.t: Usage: Rhetorical adverb negating necessity or criticizing unwarranted exertion/conflict (何必 + Verb/Clause (+ 呢)?). Example: 邻里之间何必为了争夺一处临街摊位而闹得不可开交呢？; Línlǐ zhījiān hébì wèile zhēngduó yí chù línjiē tānwèi ér nào de bùkě kāijiāo ne?; Why should neighbors create such an irreconcilable scene merely to contest a street-facing vendor stall?
documents.s: 何必; hébì; Why should...? / There is no need

documents.t: Usage: Signals unexpected reversal against expectations, mild concession with an underlying contrast, or softened conversational critique (倒 + Verb/Adj). Example: 这碗中草药熬制的热汤闻着有些刺鼻，尝起来味道倒挺鲜美的。; Zhè wǎn zhōngcǎoyào áozhì de rètāng wénzhe yǒuxiē cìbí, cháng qǐlái wèidào dào tǐng xiānměi de.; This hot broth brewed with herbal medicine smells somewhat pungent, but tasting it, the flavor is actually quite savory.
documents.s: 倒; dào; Contrarily / Actually / On the contrary

documents.t: Usage: Connective adverb showing that the ensuing outcome developed in exact opposition to logical anticipation (Condition, 反而 + Result). Example: 央行宣布降息后股市没有上涨，反而引发了一轮恐慌性的抛售潮。; Yāngháng xuānbù jiàngxī hòu gǔshì méiyǒu shàngzhǎng, fǎn'ér yǐnfāle yì lún kǒnghuāngxìng de pāoshòucháo.; After the central bank announced an interest rate cut, the stock market did not rise, but instead triggered a round of panic selling.
documents.s: 反而; fǎn'ér; On the contrary / Instead

documents.t: Usage: Highlights frustrating counter-coincidence ("as luck would have it") or willful contrariness against expectations or advice (偏偏 + Verb). Example: 戏剧即将开演，他偏偏把那张千辛万苦抢到的VIP门票落在了出租车上。; Xìjù jíjiāng kāiyǎn, tā piānpiān bǎ nà zhāng qiānxīnwànkǔ qiǎngdào de VIP ménpiào là zài le chūzūchē shàng.; Just as the drama was about to start, contrary to all wishes he left that VIP ticket he scrambled to acquire in the taxi.
documents.s: 偏偏; piānpiān; Perversely / Contrary to wishes

documents.t: Usage: Appeals to a fundamental truth, foundational constraint, or overriding reality to explain, rationalize, or contextualize an imperfect state (毕竟 + Clause). Example: 请不要对这位初出茅庐的陶瓷手艺人过于苛求，他毕竟只学了三年陶艺。; Qǐng búyào duì zhè wèi chūchūmáolú de táocí shǒuyìrén guòyú kēqiú, tā bìjìng zhǐ xuéle sān nián táoyì.; Please do not be overly demanding of this novice ceramic artisan; after all, he has only studied ceramics for three years.
documents.s: 毕竟; bìjìng; After all / In the final analysis

documents.t: Usage: Expresses unconditional resolve or irrelevance of antecedent variables ("no matter what happens, the outcome remains fixed") (反正 + Clause). Example: 反正今晚已经错过了最后一趟城际动车，我们索性在附近找家客栈住下吧。; Fǎnzhèng jīnwǎn yǐjīng cuòguòle zuìhòu yí tàng chéngjì dòngchē, wǒmen suǒxìng zài fùjìn zhǎo jiā kèzhàn zhùxià ba.; In any case we have already missed the final intercity bullet train tonight; we might as well find an inn nearby to stay.
documents.s: 反正; fǎnzhèng; In any case / Regardless

documents.t: Usage: Denotes exact temporal, spatial, or numerical alignment without discrepancy; emphasizes opportune coincidence (刚好 + Verb/Numeral). Example: 贵宾走进餐厅时，大堂靠窗的位置刚好腾出了一张精致的八仙桌。; Guìbīn zǒujìn cāntīng shí, dàtáng kàochuāng de wèizhì gānghǎo téngchūle yì zhāng jīngzhì de bāxiānzhuō.; When the VIP walked into the restaurant, a refined square dining table had just opened up by the window in the lobby.
documents.s: 刚好; gānghǎo; Just / By coincidence

documents.t: Usage: Interchangeable with 刚好, signifying precise confluence of conditions, timing, or dimensions (正好 + Verb/Adj). Example: 门卫递过来的那把折叠雨伞，正好挡住了迎面泼来的冰冷雨水。; Ménwèi dì guòlái de nà bǎ zhédié yǔsǎn, zhènghǎo dǎngzhùle yíngmiàn pō lái de bīnglěng yǔshuǐ.; That folding umbrella handed over by the doorman just happened to block the freezing rain splashing from ahead.
documents.s: 正好; zhènghǎo; Coincidentally / Just right

documents.t: Usage: Highlights that a fortunate intervention averted an imminent calamity or adverse development (幸亏...，才/不然...). Example: 幸亏那名地质勘探员戴了一顶坚固的安全帽，才没被滚落的碎石击伤头部。; Xìngkuī nà míng dìzhì kāntànyuán dàile yì dǐng jiāngù de ānquánmào, cái méi bèi gǔnluò de suìshí jīshāng tóubù.; Fortunately that geological prospector was wearing a sturdy hard hat, preventing him from suffering a head injury from rolling gravel.

Usage: Attentive emotional gratitude attributing deliverance from misfortune to a specific agent, entity, or action (多亏了 + Noun/Clause). Example: 多亏那艘破浪赶来的海警搜救艇，遇险的渔民才能脱离那片风暴漩涡。; Duōkuī nà sōu pòlàng gǎnlái de hǎijǐng sōujiùtǐng, yùxiǎn de yúmín cái néng tuōlí nà piàn fēngbào xuánwō.; Thanks to that coast guard rescue boat arriving through the waves, the imperiled fishermen were able to escape that storm vortex.
documents.s: 多亏; duōkuī; Thanks to / Luckily

documents.t: Usage: Conveys profound subjective relief that a desired objective has materialized after long delays, arduous setbacks, or intense anticipation (总算 + Verb). Example: 历经十四个小时的艰苦跋涉，搜救队员总算在深夜抵达了那座被困的山顶营地。; Lìjīng shísì gè xiǎoshí de jiānkǔ báshè, sōujiù duìyuán zǒngsuàn zài shēnyè dǐdále nà zuò bèikùn de shāndǐng yíngdì.; After undergoing fourteen hours of grueling trekking, the search and rescue team at long last reached that stranded mountaintop camp late at night.
documents.s: 总算; zǒngsuàn; At long last / Finally

documents.t: Usage: Marks a decisive, radical choice to adopt a direct, straightforward approach, abandoning tedious interim compromises (索性 + Verb). Example: 既然那台机械打字机彻底坏了，作家索性换用了一台全新的轻薄笔记本电脑。; Jìrán nà tái jīxiè dǎzìjī chèdǐ huàile, zuòjiā suǒxìng huànyòngle yì tái quánxīn de qīngbáo bǐjìběn diànnǎo.; Since that mechanical typewriter broke completely, the author simply switched to a brand-new ultrathin laptop.
documents.s: 索性; suǒxìng; Might as well / Simply

documents.t: Usage: Indicates that a course of action is chosen reluctantly as the sole remaining, unideal alternative due to external constraints (只好 + Verb). Example: 由于前方铁路线遭遇严重积雪，站长只好让这列国际货运班列暂时滞留在站台。; Yóuyú qiánfāng tiělùxiàn zāoyù yánzhòng jīxuě, zhànzhǎng zhǐhǎo ràng zhè liè guójì huòyùn bānliè zànshí zhìliú zài zhàntái.; Because the rail line ahead suffered severe snow accumulation, the stationmaster had no choice but to let this international cargo freight train remain stranded at the platform.
documents.s: 只好; zhǐhǎo; Have no choice but to

documents.t: Usage: Formal expression meaning "having no alternative"; functions as an adjective, predicative complement, or inside the formula 在不得已的情况下 ("under forced circumstances"). Example: 董事会在不得已的情况下关闭了那间持续亏损三年的海外旗舰店。; Dǒngshìhuì zài bùdéyǐ de qíngkuàng xià guānbìle nà jiān chíxù kuīsǔn sān nián de hǎiwài qíjiàndiàn.; Under circumstances of having no other choice, the board of directors closed that overseas flagship store that had run losses for three consecutive years.
documents.s: 不得已; bùdéyǐ; Forced to / Against one's will

documents.t: Usage: Signals an intentional trade-off where the speaker consciously accepts an agonizing cost to avert an intolerable dishonor or worse disaster (宁可 A，也不/也要 B). Example: 这位严谨的学者宁可放弃那笔丰厚的商业赞助，也绝不篡改任何一条实验数据。; Zhè wèi yánjǐn de xuézhě nìngkě fàngqì nà bǐ fēnghòu de shāngyè zànzhù, yě jué bù cuàngǎi rènhé yì tiáo shíyàn shùjù.; This rigorous scholar would rather forfeit that generous commercial sponsorship than tamper with a single piece of experimental data.
documents.s: 宁可; nìngkě; Would rather / Prefer to

documents.t: Usage: Denotes an unavoidable objective tendency or natural consequence under specific empirical dynamics (难免 + Verb/Adj). Example: 传统制造业在推进这一场深刻的数字化转型时，难免会遭遇局部的阵痛。; Chuántǒng zhìzàoyè zài tuījìn zhè yì chǎng shēnkè de shùzìhuà zhuǎnxíng shí, nánmiǎn huì zāoyù júbù de zhèntòng.; When traditional manufacturing advances this profound digital transformation, it is hard to avoid localized growing pains.
documents.s: 难免; nánmiǎn; Hard to avoid / Inevitable

documents.t: Usage: Descriptive tone adverb emphasizing spontaneous emotional reactions or psychological states that naturally erupt under situational catalysts (心中不免...). Example: 游子在异国他乡捧读那一封发黄的旧家书，心中不免泛起阵阵乡愁。; Yóuzǐ zài yìguótāxiāng pěngdú nà yì fēng fāhuáng de jiù jiāshū, xīnzhōng bùmiǎn fànqǐ zhènzhèn xiāngchóu.; The wanderer holding and reading that yellowed old family letter in a foreign land could not help but feel waves of homesickness welling up.
documents.s: 不免; bùmiǎn; Unavoidably / Cannot help but

documents.t: Usage: Softens an evaluative criticism, expressing polite disagreement while implying that someone has crossed an acceptable threshold (未免 + 太/过于...). Example: 校方因为学生迟到一次就给予记过处分，这项决定未免太苛刻了。; Xiàofāng yīnwèi xuésheng chídào yí cì jiù jǐyǔ jìguò chǔfèn, zhè xiàng juédìng wèimiǎn tài kēkè le.; The school giving a demerit sanction because a student was late once—this decision is truly a bit too harsh.
documents.s: 未免; wèimiǎn; Rather / Truly a bit too

documents.t: Usage: Expresses unconditional, radical negation from the very root (根本 + 不/没/无); rejects the validity of the premise entirely. Example: 质监局证实那家小作坊出产的这一批劣质零件根本不符合国家工业安全标准。; Zhìjiānjú zhèngshí nà jiā xiǎozuòfang chūchǎn de zhè yì pī lièzhì língjiàn gēnběn bù fúhé guójiā gōngyè ānquán biāozhǔn.; The quality supervision bureau confirmed that this batch of substandard parts produced by that small workshop does not conform to national industrial safety standards at all.
documents.s: 根本; gēnběn; At all / Fundamentally

documents.t: Usage: Intensifier used to introduce hyperbole, vivid characterizations, or startling descriptions as if they were literal truth (简直 + Verb/Predicate). Example: 青年画家创作的这幅全景水墨画气势磅礴，技艺简直堪称鬼斧神工。; Qīngnián huàjiā chuàngzuò de zhè fú quánjǐng shuǐmòhuà qìshì pángbó, jìyì jiǎnzhí kānchēng guǐfǔshéngōng.; This panoramic ink wash painting created by the young painter is breathtakingly grand; the artistry can simply be hailed as superhuman perfection.

Usage: Marks an extreme, unexpected illustrative case that extends the baseline, highlighting radical progression (甚至 + Verb/Noun). Example: 电信公司推进数字基建，甚至在那座悬崖上的偏远山村架设了一座5G基站。; Diànxìn gōngsī tuījìn shùzì jījiàn, shènzhì zài nà zuò xuányá shàng de piānyuǎn shāncūn jiàshèle yí zuò 5G jīzhàn.; The telecom company advanced digital infrastructure, even erecting a 5G base station in that remote mountain village perched upon a cliff.
documents.s: 甚至; shènzhì; Even / So much that

documents.t: Usage: Introduces an a fortiori argument; points out a more obvious, compelling subsequent condition that reinforces the preceding statement (..., 何况...呢). Example: 资深文史研究员翻译这本古籍尚且感到吃力，何况是缺乏基础的初学者呢？; Zīshēn wénshǐ yánjiūyuán fānyì zhè běn gǔjí shàngqiě gǎndào chīlì, hékuàng shì quēfá jīchǔ de chūxuézhě ne?; Even veteran literature and history researchers find translating this ancient tome arduous, let alone beginners lacking foundational training?
documents.s: 何况; hékuàng; Much less / Let alone

documents.t: Usage: Imparts rapid immediacy, swift realization, or assertive focal alignment between condition and outcome (Condition + 就 + Result). Example: 天才少年看了一眼黑板上的那道奥数难题，当场就在草稿纸上写出了答案。; Tiāncái shàonián kànle yì yǎn hēibǎn shàng de nà dào àoshù nántí, dāngchǎng jiù zài cǎogǎozhǐ shàng xiěchūle dá'àn.; The prodigy glanced once at that mathematical olympiad problem on the blackboard, and wrote down the solution on his scratch paper right on the spot.
documents.s: 就; jiù; Directly / As early as / Right away

documents.t: Usage: Confirms that a historic state or persistent functionality remains unbroken despite elapsed time, obstacles, or deterioration (还 + Verb/Adj). Example: 那座历经数百年风雨侵蚀的石拱桥，如今还承担着两岸村民的日常通行需求。; Nà zuò lìjīng shù bǎi nián fēngyǔ qīnshí de shí gǒngqiáo, rújīn hái chéngdānzhe liǎng'àn cūnmín de rìcháng tōngxíng xūqiú.; That stone arch bridge that weathered centuries of wind and rain erosion still serves the everyday commuting needs of villagers on both banks today.

Mandarin negation adverbs modulate propositional truth along two grammatical axes: aspectual realization (habitual/stative denial vs. perfective non-completion) and pragmatic force (objective refutation vs. deontic prohibition vs. epistemic reservation). Syntactically, negators occupy the immediate pre-verbal or pre-adjectival slot, strictly barring perfective aspect particles like 了 from co-occurring in the predicate.

Usage: Default negator for timeless facts, habitual behaviors, volitional intent, future projections, and gradable adjectives (不 + Verb/Adj); incompatible with completed aspect (*不 + Verb + 了). Example: 那家跨国制药企业坚决不妥协，拒绝签署一份附带不合理条款的授权合同。; Nà jiā kuàguó zhìyào qǐyè jiānjué bù tuǒxié, jùjué qiānshǔ yí fèn fùdài bù hélǐ tiáokuǎn de shòuquán hétong.; That multinational pharmaceutical enterprise resolutely refuses to compromise, declining to sign a licensing contract attached with unreasonable clauses.

Usage: Aspectual negator indicating the non-realization or non-completion of an action in the past or present (没 + Verb), or the absence of an entity (没有 + Noun). Example: 质检员在彻底核验前没在那批精密轴承的出厂合格证上盖章。; Zhìjiǎnyuán zài chèdǐ héyàn qián méi zài nà pī jīngmì zhóuchéng de chūchǎng hégézhèng shàng gàizhāng.; The quality inspector did not stamp the factory conformity certificate of that batch of precision bearings prior to a thorough verification.
documents.s: 没; méi; Have not / Did not

documents.t: Usage: Formal and written aspectual negator denoting "not yet occurred" or "not having reached"; substitutes for 没有 in administrative, legal, and academic texts (未 + Verb). Example: 城市规划委员会至今尚未批准那一套极具争议的高架桥拓宽方案。; Chéngshì guīhuà wěiyuánhuì zhìjīn shàngwèi pīzhǔn nà yí tào jí jù zhēngyì de gāojiàqiáo tuòkuān fāng'àn.; The urban planning committee has not yet approved that highly controversial viaduct widening scheme to this day.
documents.s: 未; wèi; Not yet / Have not

documents.t: Usage: Conversational prohibitive adverb used to issue negative commands, dissuasions, or preventative warnings (别 + Verb (+ 了)). Example: 领队严厉警告队员别靠近那一处极易发生坍塌的陡峭冰裂缝。; Lǐngduì yánlì jǐnggào duìyuán bié kàojìn nà yí chù jí yì fāshēng tāntā de dǒuqiào bīnglièfèng.; The team leader sternly warned members not to approach that steep crevasse that is extremely prone to collapsing.

Usage: Formal and classical prohibitive particle used in official notices, legal statutes, and public cautionary signs (请勿 / 切勿 + Verb). Example: 博物馆在展厅入口设立警示牌，提醒观众切勿抚摸那尊珍贵的北魏石雕佛像。; Bówùguǎn zài zhǎntīng rùkǒu shèlì jǐngshìpái, tíxǐng guānzhòng qièwù fǔmō nà zūn zhēnguì de Běiwèi shídiāo fóxiàng.; The museum erected a warning sign at the exhibition entrance, reminding visitors under no circumstances to touch that precious Northern Wei stone Buddha sculpture.

Usage: Emphatic modal negator expressing uncompromising personal resolution, formal defiance, or non-negotiable rejection (决不 + Verb). Example: 恪尽职守的船长立下誓言，在所有乘客撤离前决不离开那艘受损的客轮。; Kèjìnzhíshǒu de chuánzhǎng lìxià shìyán, zài suǒyǒu chéngkè chèlí qián juébù líkāi nà sōu shòusǔn de kèlún.; The dutiful captain made a vow that under no circumstances would he leave that damaged passenger ship before all passengers had evacuated.
documents.s: 决不; juébù; Under no circumstances / Definitely not

documents.t: Usage: Scalar intensifier negating an attribute down to zero magnitude (毫不 + Two-syllable Verb/Adj); frequently heads psychological and action verbs like 犹豫 (hesitate) or 动摇 (waver). Example: 年轻的消防战士毫不犹豫地冲进那栋浓烟滚滚的木质居民楼展开搜救。; Niánqīng de xiāofáng zhànshì háobù yóuyù de chōngjìn nà dòng nóngyān gǔngǔn de mùzhì jūmínlóu zhǎnkāi sōujiù.; The young firefighter rushed into that wooden apartment building billowing dense smoke without the slightest hesitation to launch a rescue.
documents.s: 毫不; háobù; Not in the least / Without an iota of

documents.t: Usage: Classical and formal negator asserting the total absence of a property or condition; directly governs abstract noun objects (无 + Noun) or acts within four-character compounds (毫无偏私). Example: 这位公正的审判长在做出最终裁决时毫无偏私，充分体现了法律的尊严。; Zhè wèi gōngzhèng de shěnpànzhǎng zài zuòchū zuìzhōng cáijué shí háowú piānsī, chōngfèn tǐxiànle fǎlǜ de zūnyán.; When making the final ruling, this impartial presiding judge was completely devoid of personal bias, fully exemplifying the dignity of the law.

Usage: Epistemic modal negator that qualifies an absolute assumption, indicating uncertainty or rejecting categorical determinism without asserting a direct opposite (未必 + Verb/Adj). Example: 企业即便斥巨资引进这一批自动化设备，其实际产能也未必能立即翻倍。; Qǐyè jíbiàn chì jùzī yǐnjìn zhè yì pī zìdònghuà shèbèi, qí shíjì chǎnnéng yě wèibì néng lìjí fānbèi.; Even if the enterprise spends massive capital to introduce this batch of automated equipment, its actual production capacity may not necessarily double immediately.
documents.s: 未必; wèibì; Not necessarily / May not

documents.t: Usage: Classical copular negator meaning "is not"; primarily functions in modern grammar within the correlative double-negative construction 非...不可 to express categorical obligation or inescapable outcome. Example: 宇航员非经历这一套严酷的高原低氧适应性特训不可，方能适应空间站环境。; Yǔhángyuán fēi jīnglì zhè yí tào yánkù de gāoyuán dīyǎng shìyìngxìng tèxùn bùkě, fāng néng shìyìng kōngjiānzhàn huánjìng.; The astronauts must undergo this rigorous set of high-altitude hypoxic adaptation training in order to adapt to the space station environment.
documents.s: 非; fēi; Is not / Non- / Must (in double negative)

documents.t: Scope and restriction adverbs delimit the semantic domain of predicates, quantifying participant totality, imposing exclusive boundaries, or aggregating spatial and numerical breadths. Syntactically, they occupy the pre-verbal or pre-quantifier slot, frequently anchoring correlative constructions that summarize preceding subjects or conditional clauses.

Usage: Left-associative universal quantifier summarizing preceding plural subjects, fronted objects, or conditional scopes (Subject(Plural) + 都 + Predicate). Example: 参与会诊的几位主治医师都赞同这套手术方案。; Cānyù huìzhěn de jǐ wèi zhǔzhì yīshī dōu zàntóng zhè tào shǒushù fāng'àn.; The several attending physicians participating in the consultation all endorsed this surgical plan. note Add example for Partial/Total Negation and "Both"

Usage: Colloquial and emphatic totality adverb meaning "all without exception"; frequently summarizes multi-item direct objects in 把-disposition constructions or fronted topicalized lists. Example: 档案管理员把这批过期的合同文件统统归入了一间地下储藏室。; Dàng'ǎn guǎnlǐyuán bǎ zhè pī guòqī de hétong wénjiàn tǒngtǒng guīrù le yì jiān dìxià chǔcángshì.; The archivist sorted all these expired contract documents without exception into an underground storage room.
documents.s: 统统; tǒngtǒng; All / Entirely / Completely

documents.t: Usage: Dual-function word acting as an exhaustive noun-modifier or an adverbial marker denoting 100% completion or participation across an entire inventory. Example: 工程队在上周末已经全部完成了那条跨江大桥的铺轨工作。; Gōngchéngduì zài shàng zhōumò yǐjīng quánbù wánchéngle nà tiáo kuàjiāng dàqiáo de pūguǐ gōngzuò.; The engineering team had completely finished the track-laying work of that cross-river bridge last weekend.
documents.s: 全部; quánbù; Whole / Entire / Completely

documents.t: Usage: Prescriptive scope adverb meaning "treated uniformly alike"; standard in legal codes, institutional regulations, policy enforcement, and administrative guidelines (一律 + Verb). Example: 这家连锁酒店规定所有客房在午夜后一律停止供应酒精饮料。; Zhè jiā liánsuǒ jiǔdiàn guīdìng suǒyǒu kèfáng zài wǔyè hòu yílǜ tíngzhǐ gōngyìng jiǔjīng yǐnliào.; This hotel chain stipulates that all guest rooms without exception must cease alcoholic beverage service after midnight.
documents.s: 一律; yílǜ; Without exception / Universally

documents.t: Usage: Universal distributive marker placed at the beginning of noun phrases or conditional clauses to define an open class ("whatever / every single"); obligatorily pairs with 都 or 一律 in the matrix clause (凡是...都/一律...). Example: 凡是获得国家基金资助的科研项目都必须提交一份详细的结题报告。; Fánshì huòdé guójiā jījīn zīzhù de kēyán xiàngmù dōu bìxū tíjiāo yí fèn xiángxì de jiétí bàogào.; Every scientific research project funded by the national fund must submit a detailed completion report.
documents.s: 凡是; fánshì; Every / Any / All

documents.t: Usage: Marks absolute fulfillment, totality of scope, or unconditional degree; directly precedes predicates or negative particles (完全不 / 完全没) to denote absolute non-existence or categorical disagreement. Example: 专家组确认那座在地震中受损的古桥结构已经完全恢复了稳定。; Zhuānjiāzǔ quèrèn nà zuò zài dìzhèn zhōng shòusǔn de gǔqiáo jiégòu yǐjīng wánquán huìfù le wěndìng.; The expert panel confirmed that the structure of that ancient bridge damaged in the earthquake has completely recovered its stability.
documents.s: 完全; wánquán; Completely / Entirely / Totally

documents.t: Usage: Summation adverb placed immediately before numeral-classifier phrases to aggregate individuals, inventory, or temporal units into a combined total (一共 + Numeral-Classifier). Example: 出版社为这套科普丛书一共设计了十二册独立的专题绘本。; Chūbǎnshè wèi zhè tào kēpǔ cóngshū yígòng shèjìle shí'èr cè dúlì de zhuāntí huìběn.; The publishing house designed a total of twelve independent thematic picture books for this popular science series.
documents.s: 一共; yígòng; Altogether / In total

documents.t: Usage: Formal aggregation adverb synonymous with 一共, predominantly used in administrative accounts, macroeconomic statistics, corporate auditing, and budgetary audits. Example: 审计局核算出开发商总共挪用了一笔高达五千万元的专项改造基金。; Shěnjìjú hésuàn chū kāifāshāng zǒnggòng nuóyòngle yì bǐ gāodá wǔqiānwàn yuán de zhuānxiàng gǎizào jījīn.; The audit bureau calculated that the developer misappropriated a total of fifty million yuan in special renovation funds.
documents.s: 总共; zǒnggòng; In total / Altogether

documents.t: Usage: Primary restrictive adverb establishing strict exclusivity by eliminating all alternative candidates outside the designated target (只 + Verb/Predicate). Example: 巡护员在那片原始森林里只发现了一株极其罕见的野生兰花。; Xúnhùyuán zài nà piàn yuánshǐ sēnlín lǐ zhǐ fāxiànle yì zhū jíqí hǎnjiàn de yěshēng lánhuā.; The patrol ranger found only a single, extremely rare wild orchid in that primeval forest.

Usage: Spoken restrictive adverb emphasizing that a solitary action, entity, or factor is singled out; carries the pragmatic implication that the isolated element is insufficient by itself. Example: 教练提醒学员光依靠节食而不配合一套科学的训练计划很难保持健康。; Jiàoliàn tíxǐng xuéyuán guāng yīkào jiéshí ér bù pèihé yí tào kēxué de xùnliàn jìhuà hěn nán bǎochí jiànkāng.; The coach reminded the trainees that merely relying on dieting without accompanying a scientific training plan makes it difficult to maintain health.

Usage: Formal restrictive modifier highlighting small numerical quantities, restricted scales, or minimal durations; frequently coordinates with restrictive post-verbal structures like 而已 or 不到. Example: 这列新型磁悬浮列车仅仅花费了十五分钟就跨越了整座海峡。; Zhè liè xīnxíng cíxuánfú lièchē jǐnjǐn huāfèile shíwǔ fēnzhōng jiù kuàyuèle zhěng zuò hǎixiá.; This new type of maglev train took merely fifteen minutes to cross the entire strait.
documents.s: 仅仅; jǐnjǐn; Merely / Barely / Only

documents.t: Usage: Locative scope adverb meaning "in every place"; precedes predicates without requiring prepositions, denoting pervasive spatial distribution across an entire setting (到处 + 都 + Verb). Example: 春季的清晨，游客漫步在那座植物园里到处都能闻到泥土与花草的芬芳。; Chūnjì de qīngchén, yóukè mànbù zài nà zuò zhíwùyuán lǐ dàochù dōu néng wéndào nítǔ yǔ huācǎo de fēnfāng.; On a spring morning, tourists strolling in that botanical garden can smell the fragrance of soil and flowers everywhere.
documents.s: 到处; dàochù; Everywhere / In all places

documents.t: Usage: Delimits the broad conceptual boundaries or essential contours of an action, inventory, or proposition, bypassing trivial operational details (大致 + Verb/Predicate). Example: 测绘员在现场大致勾勒出了一张反映山体滑坡范围的地形草图。; Cèhuìyuán zài xiànchǎng dàzhì gōulè chūle yì zhāng fǎnyìng shāntǐ huápō fànwéi de dìxíng cǎotú.; On site, the surveyor roughly sketched a topographical outline reflecting the scope of the landslide.
documents.s: 大致; dàzhì; Roughly / More or less / In general

documents.t: Usage: Connective scope adverb indicating semantic parallel, shared state, or inclusive concurrence with a prior referent; must precede other auxiliary verbs, prepositions, or negation words (也 + Verb/Adj). Example: 经过数月磋商，那支欧洲代表团也正式签署了这份涉及绿色能源的合作备忘录。; Jīngguò shù yuè cuōshāng, nà zhī Ōuzhōu dàibiǎotuán yě zhèngshì qiānshǔle zhè fèn shèjí lǜsè néngyuán de hézuò bèiwànglù.; After months of deliberations, that European delegation also formally signed this memorandum of cooperation regarding green energy.

Usage: Boundary-setting adverb indicating operating within the absolute upper or lower practical thresholds of capacity; modifies dynamic action verbs aiming to maximize or minimize an outcome (尽量 + Verb). Example: 研发人员正努力改进配方，尽量降低这剂新型抗生素引发的过敏反应。; Yánfā rényuán zhèng nǔlì gǎijìn pèifāng, jǐnliàng jiàngdī zhè jì xīnxíng kàngshēngsù yǐnfā de guòmǐn fǎnyìng.; The research personnel are striving to refine the formula to minimize as much as possible the allergic reactions triggered by this dose of novel antibiotic.
documents.s: 尽量; jǐnliàng; To the best of one's ability / To the utmost

documents.t: Time adverbs establish temporal location relative to the moment of speech, while aspectual adverbs delineate the phase, duration, and continuity of an event. These markers precede verbs or adjectives to indicate whether an action is completed, ongoing, imminent, or progressing incrementally.

Usage: 曾经 + Verb (+ 过): Preverbal modifier indicating an action was experienced in the past and is no longer ongoing. Example: 他曾经在这家跨国企业担任过市场部经理。; Tā céngjīng zài zhè jiā kuàguó qǐyè dānrèn guo shìchǎngbù jīnglǐ.; He once served as the marketing manager in this multinational enterprise.
documents.s: 曾经; céngjīng; Once / Previously / Ever

documents.t: Usage: 已经 + Verb / Predicate (+ 了): Marks the completion of an action or the attainment of a state before the reference time. Example: 财务部门已经把上个月的报表审核完毕了。; Cáiwù bùmén yǐjīng bǎ shàng gè yuè de bàobiǎo shěnhé wánbì le.; The finance department has already finished auditing last month's report.

Usage: Subject + 刚 + Verb: Monosyllabic adverb placed strictly after the subject to indicate an action occurred moments prior. Example: 我们刚办完那笔房屋贷款手续。; Wǒmen gāng bàn wán nà bǐ fángwū dàikuǎn shǒuxù.; We just finished processing that housing loan procedure.
documents.s: 刚; gāng; Just / Only a moment ago

documents.t: Usage: (Time / Subject) + 刚刚 + Verb: Time adverbial placed either before or after the subject indicating recent occurrence. Example: 那场关于环境保护的辩论赛刚刚结束。; Nà chǎng guānyú huánjìng bǎohù de biànlùnsài gānggang jiéshù.; That debate competition on environmental protection just concluded.
documents.s: 刚刚; gānggang; Just now / A moment ago

documents.t: Usage: Time / Condition + 才 + Verb: Denotes that an action occurred late, slowly, or only after meeting a difficult prerequisite. Example: 经过三个小时的协商，双方才达成一致。; Jīngguò sān gè xiǎoshí de xiéshāng, shuāngfāng cái dáchéng yízhì.; Only after three hours of consultation did both sides reach an agreement.
documents.s: 才; cái; Only then / Not until

documents.t: Usage: 正在 + Verb (+ 呢): Highlights that a dynamic action is actively in progress at the anchor moment. Example: 技术人员正在调试那台进口精密仪器。; Jìshù rényuán zhèngzài tiáoshì nà tái jìnkǒu jīngmì yíqì.; The technicians are debugging that imported precision instrument right now.
documents.s: 正在; zhèngzài; In the process of / Right now

documents.t: Usage: 在 + Verb (+ 呢): Core progressive aspect marker denoting ongoing action. Example: 设计师在修改那个新产品的包装方案。; Shèjìshī zài xiūgǎi nà ge xīn chǎnpǐn de bāozhuāng fāng'àn.; The designer is modifying the packaging proposal for that new product.
documents.s: 在; zài; In the middle of

documents.t: Usage: 一直 + Verb / Predicate: Denotes uninterrupted temporal continuation of an action or consistent adherence to a state. Example: 这项科研项目一直面临着资金短缺的困境。; Zhè xiàng kēyán xiàngmù yìzhí miànlínzhe zījīn duǎnquē de kùnjìng.; This scientific research project has all along faced the dilemma of funding shortages.
documents.s: 一直; yìzhí; Continuously / All along

documents.t: Usage: 始终 + Verb / Negation: Stresses unwavering persistence of an attitude, principle, or habit through the entire timeframe (cannot refer to future actions). Example: 面对巨大的竞争压力，他始终保持着乐观的心态。; Miànduì jùdà de jìngzhēng yālì, tā shǐzhōng bǎochízhe lèguān de xīntài.; Facing immense competitive pressure, he maintained an optimistic mindset from beginning to end.
documents.s: 始终; shǐzhōng; From beginning to end / Always

documents.t: Usage: 仍然 + Verb / Adj: Objective adverb indicating that a previous state remains unchanged despite expectations or external shifts. Example: 尽管市场竞争激烈，这家老字号仍然拥有稳定的客源。; Jǐnguǎn shìchǎng jìngzhēng jīliè, zhè jiā lǎozìhào réngrán yōngyǒu wěndìng de kèyuán.; Despite fierce market competition, this time-honored shop still possesses a stable customer base.
documents.s: 仍然; réngrán; Still / Yet / As before

documents.t: Usage: 依然 + Verb / Adj: Literary equivalent to 仍然; emphasizes persistent, undisturbed continuation of an original state. Example: 离开故乡多年，那座古老的钟楼依然伫立在广场中央。; Líkāi gùxiāng duō nián, nà zuò gǔlǎo de zhōnglóu yīrán zhùlì zài guǎngchǎng zhōngyāng.; Having left the hometown for many years, that ancient bell tower still stands in the center of the square.
documents.s: 依然; yīrán; Still / As ever

documents.t: Usage: 从来 + 不 / 没(有) + Verb: Indicates that a condition or habit has applied without exception from the past up to the present. Example: 那位严谨的教授从来没有缺席过任何一次学术研讨会。; Nà wèi yánjǐn de jiàoshòu cónglái méiyǒu quēxí guo rènhé yí cì xuéshù yántǎohuì.; That rigorous professor has never once been absent from any academic seminar.
documents.s: 从来; cónglái; Always / Never (with negation)

documents.t: Usage: 马上 + Verb: Denotes action occurring immediately or very shortly after the anchor time. Example: 维修工程师马上过来排查这台发动机的故障。; Wéixiū gōngchéngshī mǎshàng guòlai páichá zhè tái fādòngjī de gùzhàng.; The maintenance engineer will come immediately to troubleshoot the malfunction of this engine.
documents.s: 马上; mǎshàng; Immediately / Right away

documents.t: Usage: 立刻 + Verb: Emphasizes instantaneous temporal response with zero elapsed time; more formal than 马上. Example: 听到火警铃声，全体员工立刻疏散到了安全地带。; Tīngdào huǒjǐng língshēng, quántǐ yuángōng lìkè shūsàn dào le ānquán dìdài.; Upon hearing the fire alarm, the entire staff evacuated to a safe area at once.
documents.s: 立刻; lìkè; Promptly / At once

documents.t: Usage: 即将 + Verb: Formal written adverb denoting imminent transition into an anticipated event. Example: 那部耗时三年拍摄的纪录片即将公映。; Nà bù hàoshí sān nián pāishè de jìlùpiàn jíjiāng gōngyìng.; That documentary film, which took three years to shoot, is about to be publicly released.

Usage: 快要 + Verb / Adj + 了: Imminent aspect frame marking an event about to occur; cannot co-occur with specific clock times. Example: 飞往伦敦的那趟国际航班快要停止登机了。; Fēiwǎng Lúndūn de nà tàng guójì hángbān kuàiyào tíngzhǐ dēngjī le.; That international flight bound for London is about to close boarding.
documents.s: 快要; kuàiyào; About to / Soon

documents.t: Usage: Clause 1，紧接着 + Clause 2: Temporal connector showing immediate sequential occurrence without interruption. Example: 开幕式致辞完毕，紧接着举行了隆重的签约仪式。; Kāimùshì zhìcí wánbì, jǐnjiēzhe jǔxíng le lóngzhòng de qiānyuē yíshì.; The opening speeches finished, and immediately following that, a solemn signing ceremony was held.
documents.s: 紧接着; jǐnjiēzhe; Immediately after / Next

documents.t: Usage: Condition / Time + 便 + Verb: Formal and literary equivalent of 就; denotes quick sequential occurrence or a direct causal link. Example: 警方接到报案电话便迅速赶往现场。; Jǐngfāng jiēdào bào'àn diànhuà biàn xùnsù gǎnwǎng xiànchǎng.; Having received the emergency call, the police promptly rushed to the scene.

Usage: 先 + Verb 1，(再 / 然后) + Verb 2: Marks the preliminary action in a multi-step sequence. Example: 我们应当先收集消费者的反馈数据，然后再调整营销策略。; Wǒmen yīngdāng xiān shōují xiāofèizhě de fǎnkuì shùjù, ránhòu zài tiáozhěng yíngxiāo cèlüè.; We ought to first collect consumer feedback data, and then adjust our marketing strategy.

Usage: 突然 + Verb / Adj / Predicate: Functions as adverb or adjective marking an unexpected, sudden shift in conditions. Example: 行车途中，车辆前方的警示灯突然亮了起来。; Xíngchē túzhōng, chēliàng qiánfāng de jǐngshìdēng tūrán liàng le qǐlai.; Midway through driving, the warning light in front of the vehicle suddenly lit up.

Usage: (Subject) + 忽然 + Verb: Strict adverb indicating an unforeseen thought or event occurring in a split second. Example: 散步时，他脑海中忽然闪现出一个绝妙的灵感。; Sànbù shí, tā nǎohǎi zhōng hūrán shǎnxiàn chū yí gè juémiào de línggǎn.; While taking a walk, a brilliant flash of inspiration suddenly emerged in his mind.

Usage: 猛然 + Verb: Denotes an intensely sudden physical jerk, violent movement, or sharp psychological awakening. Example: 听到刹车声，坐在后排的乘客猛然惊醒。; Tīngdào shāchē shēng, zuò zài hòupái de chéngkè měngrán jīngxǐng.; Hearing the sound of screeching brakes, the passenger sitting in the back row was startled awake.

Usage: 赶紧 + Verb: Stresses urgency driven by external necessity, approaching deadlines, or weather shifts. Example: 暴风雨即将来临，港口的渔船赶紧返回码头避风。; Bàofēngyǔ jíjiāng láilín, gǎngkǒu de yúchuán gǎnjǐn fǎnhuí mǎtou bìfēng.; The storm was imminent, so the fishing boats in the harbor hurried back to the pier for shelter.
documents.s: 赶紧; gǎnjǐn; Hurriedly / Losing no time

documents.t: Usage: 赶快 + Verb: Stresses speeding up execution; dominant in spoken imperative directives. Example: 提交申请的截止日期快到了，请赶快补齐缺少的材料。; Tíjiāo shēnqǐng de jiézhǐ rìqī kuài dào le, qǐng gǎnkuài bǔqí quēshǎo de cáiliào.; The deadline to submit applications is approaching; please quickly supply the missing materials.
documents.s: 赶快; gǎnkuài; Quickly / At once

documents.t: Usage: 连忙 + Verb: Describes an immediate physical or verbal counter-action triggered directly by a preceding event. Example: 看到老教授抱着一叠沉重的书籍，班长连忙上前帮忙。; Kàndào lǎo jiàoshòu bào zhe yì dié chénzhòng de shūjí, bānzhǎng liánmáng shàngqián bāngmáng.; Seeing the old professor carrying a stack of heavy books, the class monitor promptly stepped forward to help.
documents.s: 连忙; liánmáng; Promptly / In response

documents.t: Usage: 按时 + Verb: Emphasizes compliance with an established timetable, contract, or medication schedule. Example: 建筑工人克服了恶劣天气，按时完成了桥梁加固工程。; Jiànzhù gōngrén kèfú le èliè tiānqì, ànshí wánchéng le qiáoliáng jiāgù gōngchéng.; Overcoming harsh weather, the construction workers completed the bridge reinforcement project on schedule.
documents.s: 按时; ànshí; On schedule / According to plan

documents.t: Usage: 准时 + Verb / Adj: Highlights precise adherence to an explicit clock-face time; functions as an adverb or stative predicate. Example: 开往哈尔滨的那趟高铁列车准时发车了。; Kāiwǎng Hā'ěrbīn de nà tàng gāotiě lièchē zhǔnshí fāchē le.; That high-speed train bound for Harbin departed right on the dot.
documents.s: 准时; zhǔnshí; Punctually / On the dot

documents.t: Usage: 及时 + Verb / Adj: Marks action executed at the critical opportune moment, preventing damage or solving a crisis. Example: 消防队及时扑灭了大火，没有造成人员伤亡。; Xiāofángduì jíshí pūmiè le dàhuǒ, méiyǒu zàochéng rényuán shāngwáng.; The fire brigade extinguished the blaze in time, preventing any casualties.
documents.s: 及时; jíshí; In the nick of time / Promptly

documents.t: Usage: 尽快 + Verb: Stresses compressing the required window of time to a minimum. Example: 请各位专家尽快审阅这份修改后的科研报告。; Qǐng gèwèi zhuānjiā jǐnkuài shěnyuè zhè fèn xiūgǎi hòu de kēyán bàogào.; Would all experts please review this revised scientific research report as soon as possible.
documents.s: 尽快; jǐnkuài; As soon as possible

documents.t: Usage: 随时 + Verb: Expresses that an action or service is continuously standing by under any circumstance. Example: 遇到突发系统故障，值班工程师随时可以提供技术支持。; Yùdào tūfā xìtǒng gùzhàng, zhíbān gōngchéngshī suíshí kěyǐ tígōng jìshù zhīchí.; In the event of an unexpected system failure, the engineer on duty can provide technical support at any time.
documents.s: 随时; suíshí; At any time / Whenever

documents.t: Usage: 暂时 + Verb / Noun modifier: Restricts the operational validity of an action or rule to an interim timeframe. Example: 由于资金周转困难，董事会暂时搁置了扩建工厂的计划。; Yóuyú zījīn zhōuzhuǎn kùnnan, dǒngshìhuì zànshí gēzhì le kuòjiàn gōngchǎng de jìhuà.; Due to cash flow difficulties, the board of directors temporarily shelved the plan to expand the factory.
documents.s: 暂时; zànshí; Temporarily / For the present

documents.t: Usage: 临时 + Verb / Noun modifier: Denotes an arrangement made ad-hoc, off-schedule, or directly before execution. Example: 主讲嘉宾因病缺席，组委会临时推选了一位代表上台发言。; Zhǔjiǎng jiābīn yīn bìng quēxí, zǔwěihuì línshí tuīxuǎn le yí wèi dàibiǎo shàngtái fāyán.; Because the keynote speaker was absent due to illness, the organizing committee nominated a representative at short notice to speak on stage.
documents.s: 临时; línshí; At short notice / Provisionally

documents.t: Usage: 从此 + Predicate: Designates a historical incident or agreement as the permanent starting point for a subsequent state. Example: 签下那份长期供货合同后，这家初创工坊从此走上了正轨。; Qiānxià nà fèn chángqī gōnghuò hétong hòu, zhè jiā chūchuàng gōngfāng cóngcǐ zǒushang le zhèngguǐ.; After signing that long-term supply contract, this startup workshop got on the right track from then on.
documents.s: 从此; cóngcǐ; From then on / Henceforth

documents.t: Usage: (从……) 至今 + Predicate: Traces an unbroken state or ongoing validity from an origin point up to the speech moment. Example: 那座修建于宋代的木质结构古塔至今保存完好。; Nà zuò xiūjiàn yú Sòngdài de mùzhì jiégòu gǔtǎ zhìjīn bǎocún wánhǎo.; That ancient pagoda with a wooden structure built in the Song Dynasty is well preserved to this day.
documents.s: 至今; zhìjīn; Up to now / To this day

documents.t: Usage: 迟早 + Verb / Predicate: Projects inevitable realization regardless of the temporal interval involved. Example: 只要坚持科学严谨的实验方法，研究团队迟早会攻破这个医学难题。; Zhǐyào jiānchí kēxué yánjǐn de shíyàn fāngfǎ, yánjiū tuánduì chízǎo huì gōngpò zhè ge yīxué nántí.; As long as they adhere to scientific and rigorous experimental methods, the research team will sooner or later crack this medical conundrum.
documents.s: 迟早; chízǎo; Sooner or later

documents.t: Usage: 原来 + Predicate: Unveils an underlying fact that was previously unknown or overlooked by the speaker. Example: 查验了那份原始档案，我们才发现原来这两项专利属于同一家发明机构。; Cháyàn le nà fèn yuánshǐ dàng'àn, wǒmen cái fāxiàn yuánlái zhè liǎng xiàng zhuānlì shǔyú tóng yì jiā fāmíng jīgòu.; Having examined that original file, we only then discovered that as it turns out, these two patents belong to the same inventing institution.
documents.s: 原来; yuánlái; As it turns out / Originally

documents.t: Usage: 终于 + Verb (+ 了): Marks the eventual realization of a long-awaited, hard-fought milestone. Example: 经过长达数周的艰苦谈判，两家跨国集团终于签署了并购协议。; Jīngguò cháng dá shù zhōu de jiānkǔ tánpàn, liǎng jiā kuàguó jítuán zhōngyú qiānshǔ le bìnggòu xiéyì.; Following weeks of grueling negotiations, the two multinational conglomerates finally signed the merger agreement.
documents.s: 终于; zhōngyú; Finally / At last

documents.t: Usage: 渐渐 + Verb / Adj: Depicts slow, natural, organic transformations unfolding over an extended duration. Example: 服用了那剂中草药后，患者胸口的胀痛感渐渐减轻了。; Fúyòng le nà jì zhōngcǎoyào hòu, huànzhě xiōngkǒu de zhàngtònggǎn jiànjiàn jiǎnqīng le.; After taking that dose of Chinese herbal medicine, the patient's feeling of chest pain gradually subsided.

Usage: 逐渐 + Verb / Adj: Formal equivalent to 渐渐; marks orderly, cumulative shifts in state or trend. Example: 随着一系列稳增长措施的出台，该地区的对外贸易额逐渐回升。; Suízhe yí xìliè wěn zēngzhǎng cuòshī de chūtái, gāi dìqū de duìwài màoyì'é zhújiàn huíshēng.; With the introduction of a series of growth-stabilizing measures, the foreign trade volume of this region gradually picked up.

Usage: 逐步 + Multi-syllable Action Verb: Emphasizes deliberate, planned progression carried out phase by phase. Example: 有关部门正在各个试点城市逐步推行垃圾分类制度。; Yǒuguān bùmén zhèngzài gè gè shìdiǎn chéngshì zhúbù tuīxíng lājī fēnlèi zhìdù.; Relevant departments are systematically rolling out the waste sorting system across various pilot cities step by step.
documents.s: 逐步; zhúbù; Step by step / Systematically

documents.t: Usage: 陆续 + Verb: Denotes discrete, recurring actions executed asynchronously by multiple parties with intermittent gaps. Example: 来自全球的科技代表陆续抵达了本次人工智能峰会的主会场。; Láilì quánqiú de kējì dàibiǎo lùxù dǐdá le běn cì réngōng zhìnéng fēnghuì de zhǔ huìchǎng.; Tech delegates from around the globe arrived at the main venue of this Artificial Intelligence summit one after another.
documents.s: 陆续; lùxù; In succession / One after another

documents.t: Completion of an action (when used right after a verb: Verb + 了) Instead of marking time (past/present/future), 了 does two distinct jobs: Verb + 了 : Marks the completion / realization of an action. Sentence-Final 了: Marks a change of state / new situation ("now" / "anymore"). Type Position Function Mental Shortcut 了 (Aspect) Directly after Verb Action is completed / finished "Done!" 了 (Modal) At the end of sentence A new situation / state change occurred "Things have changed / Now" Double 了 Both after verb AND at the end Action completed up to now AND still continuing "Have been doing for... and still am"

When placed directly after a verb, 了 functions as an aspect marker indicating that an action is completed or realized. info 了 le is Not Past Tense. It indicates completion of an action, not grammatical past tense. It can be used for actions completed in the past, actions happening routinely, or actions that will be completed in the future before another action begins. When using verbal 了 with a direct object, the object normally takes a specific modifier (such as a quantity, measure word, or descriptive adjective) so the sentence does not sound abruptly unfinished. Here is the updated table with all three affirmative examples consolidated into a single row: Sentence Form Chinese Pattern Example Affirmative Subj + Verb + 了 le + Quantity / Modifier + Obj 我买了一本书。 Wǒ mǎile yì běn shū. ⤷ I bought a book. 他喝了两杯咖啡。 Tā hēle liǎng bēi kāfēi. ⤷ He drank two cups of coffee. 妈妈吃了一个红苹果。 Māma chīle yí ge hóng píngguǒ. ⤷ Mom ate a red apple. Negative Subj + 没 méi / 没有 méiyǒu + Verb + Obj 我没买书。 Wǒ méi mǎi shū. ⤷ I didn't buy books. Yes/No Question Subj + Verb + Obj + 了吗 le ma? (or 没有 méiyǒu?) 你喝咖啡了吗？ Nǐ hē kāfēi le ma? ⤷ Did you drink coffee? A-not-A Question Subj + 有没有 yǒu méiyǒu + Verb + Obj？ 你有没有喝咖啡？ Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu hē kāfēi? ⤷ Did you drink coffee (or not)?
