Usage: Dual-function pronoun: (1) Refers to other people / they (synonym of 别人); (2) Colloquially and playfully refers to the speaker themselves ("me / I"), often conveying intimacy, grievance, or teasing. Example: 人家都等了你半天了！; Rénjia dōu děng le nǐ bàntiān le!; I've been waiting for you forever!
Usage: Reciprocal pronoun; indicates mutual interaction or shared state between parties. Example: 真正的朋友应该彼此信任。; Zhēnzhèng de péngyou yīnggāi bǐcǐ xìnrèn.; True friends should trust each other.

Usage: Distributive pronoun; emphasizes individual actions or attributes within a group. Example: 会议结束后，大家回到了各自的办公室。; Huìyì jiéshù hòu, dàjiā huí dào le gèzì de bàngōngshì.; After the meeting ended, everyone returned to their respective offices.

Mandarin conjunctions link linguistic units—words, phrases, or full clauses—to make syntactic cohesion and logical relationships explicit. While parallel coordinators connect grammatically equal arguments, correlative subordinators operate across paired clauses to mark transition, conditionality, causality, or progression.

Usage: Clause 1 / VP 1 + 并且 + VP 2 (coordinates two concurrent or sequential actions/predicates in a shared subject context). Example: 委员会通过了那项预算方案，并且立即启动了招标程序。; Wěiyuánhuì tōngguò le nà xiàng yùsuàn fāng'àn, bìngqiě lìjí qǐdòng le zhāobiāo chéngxù.; The committee approved that budget proposal and immediately initiated the bidding procedure.
documents.s: 并且; bìngqiě; And / Furthermore / Moreover

documents.t: Usage: Adjective / VP 1 + 而 + Adjective / VP 2 (links coordinated descriptive attributes or balanced actions). Example: 这座新建的体育馆外观宏伟而典雅。; Zhè zuò xīn jiàn de tǐyùguǎn wàiguān hóngwěi ér diǎnyǎ.; The exterior of this newly built stadium is majestic as well as elegant.
documents.s: 而; ér; And / As well as

documents.t: Usage: Noun Phrase 1 + 和 + Noun Phrase 2 (neutral coordinator linking parallel nominal constituents; rarely joins verb phrases). Example: 班主任核对了毕业生的档案和推荐信。; Bānzhǔrèn héduì le bìyèshēng de dàng'àn hé tuījiànxìn.; The homeroom teacher verified the graduates' dossiers and letters of recommendation.
documents.s: 和; hé; And / As well as

documents.t: Usage: Primary Noun Phrases + 以及 + Secondary / Appended Noun Phrase (formal written coordinator introducing supplementary or ancillary entities). Example: 该条约详细规定了各方的领海边界、渔业权以及航行准则。; Gāi tiáoyuē xiángxì guīdìng le gè fāng de lǐnghǎi biānjiè, yúyèquán yǐjí hángxíng zhǔnzé.; The treaty stipulated in detail each party's territorial sea boundaries, fishing rights, as well as navigation guidelines.
documents.s: 以及; yǐjí; As well as / Along with / And

documents.t: Usage: Noun Phrase 1 + 与 + Noun Phrase 2 (high-register, literary coordinator linking parallel nouns, concepts, or titles). Example: 历史学家潜心考证古代贸易路线与货币制度的演变。; Lìshǐxuéjiā qiǎnxīn kǎozhèng gǔdài màoyì lùxiàn yǔ huòbì zhìdù de yǎnbiàn.; Historians dedicated themselves to investigating the evolution of ancient trade routes and monetary systems.

Usage: 不但 + Clause 1，而且 / 还 + Clause 2 (introduces baseline proposition before escalating in scale, severity, or benefit). Example: 这款新型电池不但重量大幅减轻，使用寿命还延长了五年。; Zhè kuǎn xīnxíng diànchí búdàn zhòngliàng dàfú jiǎnqīng, shǐyòng shòumìng hái yáncháng le wǔ nián.; Not only is the weight of this new battery drastically reduced, but its service life is also extended by five years.

Usage: 不仅 + Clause 1，也 / 而且 + Clause 2 (signals that the initial clause is merely a subset of a broader scope). Example: 举办这场国际博览会不仅提振了当地旅游业，也吸引了数家跨国企业的关注。; Jǔbàn zhè chǎng guójì bólǎnhuì bùjǐn tízhèn le dāngdì lǚyóuyè, yě xīyǐn le shù jiā kuàguó qǐyè de guānzhù.; Hosting this international expo not only boosted local tourism, but also attracted the attention of several multinational enterprises.
documents.s: 不仅; bùjǐn; Not only / Not just

documents.t: Usage: Clause 1。此外，Clause 2 (sentence-initial transition adding an independent supplemental argument or dimension). Example: 施工队修缮了那座倾斜的钟楼；此外，他们还加固了周围的石制围栏。; Shīgōngduì xiūshàn le nà zuò qīngxié de zhōnglóu; cǐwài, tāmen hái jiāgù le zhōuwéi de shízhì wéilán.; The construction team renovated that leaning bell tower; furthermore, they reinforced the surrounding stone fences.
documents.s: 此外; cǐwài; Besides / In addition / Moreover

documents.t: Usage: Clause 1 + 而且 + Clause 2 (escalating connector; frequently pairs with 不但 or 不仅 to reinforce progressive degree). Example: 质检员发现这批布料质地粗糙，而且存在严重的褪色缺陷。; Zhìjiǎnyuán fāxiàn zhè pī bùliào zhìdì cūcāo, érqiě cúnzài yánzhòng de tuìsè quēxiàn.; The quality inspector discovered that this batch of fabric had a rough texture, and furthermore suffered from severe fading defects.
documents.s: 而且; érqiě; Furthermore / And also

documents.t: Usage: Clause 1，况且 + Clause 2 (injects an additional, often decisive factual argument that cements the preceding claim). Example: 翻越这道陡峭的雪山太危险，况且暴风雪随时可能封锁唯一的山口。; Fānyuè zhè dào dǒuqiào de xuěshān tài wēixiǎn, kuàngqiě bàofēngxuě suíshí kěnéng fēngsuǒ wéiyī de shānkǒu.; Scaling this steep snow mountain is too dangerous, moreover a blizzard could seal off the only pass at any time.

Usage: Imperative / Warning Clause，不然 + Adverse Consequence (states the negative outcome if the condition is unmet). Example: 护士必须立即给病患更换药液，不然注射针头会发生堵塞。; Hùshi bìxū lìjí gěi bìnghuàn gēnghuàn yàoyè, bùrán zhùshè zhēntóu huì fāshēng dǔsè.; The nurse must replace the patient's medicinal liquid immediately, otherwise the injection needle will become clogged.
documents.s: 不然; bùrán; Otherwise / Or else

documents.t: Usage: Alternative A + 还是 + Alternative B? (strictly restricted to interrogative options or indirect embedded choice inquiries). Example: 航天局决定先发射那枚探测卫星，还是优先安排载人货运飞船？; Hángtiānjú juédìng xiān fāshè nà méi tàncè wèixīng, háishì yōuxiān ānpái zàirén huòyùn fēichuán?; Will the space agency decide to launch that exploration satellite first, or give priority to arranging the manned cargo spacecraft?

Usage: Option A + 或者 + Option B (presents interchangeable or non-exclusionary possibilities in declarative sentences). Example: 客户可以下载那份电子对账单，或者亲自前往营业网点打印凭条。; Kèhù kěyǐ xiàzài nà fèn diànzǐ duìzhàngdān, huòzhě qīnzì qiánwǎng yíngyè wǎngdiǎn dǎyìn píngtiáo.; Customers can download that electronic statement or visit a service branch in person to print a voucher.

Usage: 要么 + Option A，要么 + Option B (sets up an exclusive disjunctive dilemma forcing a choice between two courses). Example: 被告要么全额赔偿原告的经济损失，要么依照判决接受强制执行。; Bèigào yàome quán'é péicháng yuángào de jīngjì sǔnshī, yàome yīzhào pànjué jiēshòu qiángzhì zhíxíng.; The defendant must either compensate the plaintiff's financial loss in full or accept mandatory enforcement according to the ruling.

Usage: 与其 + Rejected Path，不如 + Preferred Alternative (evaluates and dismisses an inferior plan in favor of a superior one). Example: 与其盲目扩大产能，不如投资引进一套尖端净化设备。; Yǔqí mángmù kuòdà chǎnnéng, bùrú tóuzī yǐnjìn yī tào jiānduān jìnghuà shèbèi.; Rather than blindly expanding production capacity, it is better to invest in introducing a set of cutting-edge purification equipment.
documents.s: 与其; yǔqí; Rather than / Better than

documents.t: Usage: Clause 1，不过 + Clause 2 (mild adversative modifying, supplementing, or qualifying the scope of the preceding remark). Example: 这批古董瓷器保存得相当完好，不过底座边缘有一处细微的裂痕。; Zhè pī gǔdǒng cíqì bǎocún de xiāngdāng wánhǎo, búguò dǐzuò biānyuán yǒu yī chù xìwēi de lièhén.; This batch of antique porcelain was preserved quite well; however, there is a tiny fissure along the edge of the base.
documents.s: 不过; búguò; However / But / Only that

documents.t: Usage: Clause 1，但是 + Clause 2 (standard direct adversative expressing explicit, emphatic logical contrast). Example: 侦探搜集了许多零散的线索，但是凶手依然没有留下任何指纹。; Zhēntàn sōují le xǔduō língsǎn de xiànsuǒ, dànshì xiōngshǒu yīrán méiyǒu liúxià rènhé zhǐwén.; The detective gathered many fragmented clues, but the killer still left no fingerprints behind.
documents.s: 但是; dànshì; But / However / Yet

documents.t: Usage: Clause 1，而 + Clause 2 (written adversative contrasting two comparative viewpoints, metrics, or entities). Example: 传统燃油汽车销量逐渐下滑，而混合动力车型的市场份额却稳步攀升。; Chuántǒng rányóu qìchē xiàoliàng zhújiàn xiàhuá, ér hùnhé dònglì chèxíng de shìchǎng fèn'é què wěnbù pānshēng.; Traditional fuel vehicle sales gradually declined, while the market share of hybrid models climbed steadily.
documents.s: 而; ér; But / Yet / On the other hand

documents.t: Usage: 尽管 + Objective Reality / Obstacle，(但是 / 还是 / 却) + Outcome (concessive marker acknowledging facts that fail to impede the result). Example: 尽管气温骤降至零下三十度，地质队员依然按时完成了那处岩层的钻探任务。; Jǐnguǎn qìwēn zhòujiàng zhì língxià sānshí dù, dìzhì duìyuán yīrán ànshí wánchéng le nà chù yáncéng de zuàntàn rènwu.; Even though the temperature plummeted to thirty degrees below zero, the geological team members still finished the drilling task on that stratum on time.
documents.s: 尽管; jǐnguǎn; Although / In spite of

documents.t: Usage: Clause 1，可是 + Clause 2 (spoken-to-written adversative indicating unexpected contradiction or emotional friction). Example: 采购员跑遍了城里几家药房，可是始终没有买到那种特效退烧药水。; Cǎigòuyuán pǎo biàn le chéng lǐ jǐ jiā yàofáng, kěshì shǐzhōng méiyǒu mǎi dào nà zhǒng tèxiào tuìshāo yàoshuǐ.; The purchasing agent visited several pharmacies across the city, yet never managed to buy that specific fever-reducing liquid.

Usage: Clause 1。然而，Clause 2 (formal, high-register adversative placed clause-initially to reverse a narrative expectation). Example: 探险家克服重重险阻登上了峰顶，然而一场罕见的暴风将营地彻底摧毁了。; Tànxiǎnjiā kèfú chóngchóng xiǎnzǔ dēng shàng le fēngdǐng, rán'ér yī cháng hǎnjiàn de bàofēng jiāng yíngdì chèdǐ cuīhuǐ le.; The explorer overcame myriad obstacles to reach the summit; however, a rare gale completely destroyed the camp.
documents.s: 然而; rán'ér; However / Yet / But

documents.t: Usage: 虽然 + Concessive Clause，但是 / 可是 + Main Clause (standard concessive marker conceding a point before asserting a primary counterpoint). Example: 虽然这位老工匠视力有所衰退，但他雕刻的那尊木雕依然栩栩如生。; Suīrán zhè wèi lǎo gōngjiàng shìlì yǒu suǒ shuāituì, dàn tā diāokè de nà zūn mùdiāo yīrán xǔxǔ-rúshēng.; Although this veteran craftsman's eyesight has declined somewhat, that wooden sculpture he carved is still vivid and lifelike.
documents.s: 虽然; suīrán; Although / Even though

documents.t: Usage: Subject 1 + VP 1，Subject 2 + 则 + VP 2 (formal contrastive connective placed immediately after the second subject to mark parallel comparison). Example: 主教练带领主力队员进行力量训练，替补球员则在一旁练习防守战术。; Zhǔjiàoliàn dàilǐng zhǔlì duìyuán jìnxíng lìliàng xùnliàn, tìbǔ qiúyuán zé zài yīpáng liànxí fángshǒu zhànshù.; The head coach led the main players through strength training, while the substitute players practiced defensive tactics on the sidelines.
documents.s: 则; zé; But / In contrast / While

documents.t: Usage: Action / Policy Clause + 从而 + Organic Result (formal marker uniting an implemented method directly to its ensuing consequence). Example: 农场引进了滴灌节水农业技术，从而大幅降低了水资源的消耗率。; Nóngchǎng yǐnjìn le dīguàn jiéshuǐ nóngyè jìshù, cóng'ér dàfú jiàngdī le shuǐzīyuán de xiāohàolǜ.; The farm introduced drip irrigation water-saving agricultural technology, thereby substantially decreasing the consumption rate of water resources.
documents.s: 从而; cóng'ér; Thus / Thereby / As a result

documents.t: Usage: 既然 + Established Fact / Premise，就 / 那 + Inference / Directive (takes an established premise as justification for a logical deduction or prompt). Example: 既然合约条款已经达成共识，双方代表就应该尽快举办签字仪式。; Jìrán héyuē tiáokuǎn yǐjīng dáchéng gòngshí, shuāngfāng dàibiǎo jiù yīnggāi jǐnkuài jǔbàn qiānzì yíshì.; Since the terms of the contract have reached a consensus, both delegations should organize the signing ceremony as soon as possible.
documents.s: 既然; jìrán; Since / Now that

documents.t: Usage: Factual Evidence / Observation。可见，Deductive Conclusion (draws an analytical inference directly from demonstrated evidence). Example: 仅过去一个季度就有数万名游客退订船票，可见这场传染病对邮轮产业的冲击极大。; Jǐn guòqù yī gè jīdù jiù yǒu shù wàn míng yóukè tuìdìng chuánpiào, kějiàn zhè chǎng chuánrǎnbìng duì yóulún chǎnyè de chōngjī jí dà.; Tens of thousands of tourists refunded their ship tickets in just the past quarter; thus it can be seen that this infectious disease had an enormous impact on the cruise industry.
documents.s: 可见; kějiàn; It can clearly be seen that / So

documents.t: Usage: 先 + Action 1，然后 + Action 2 (articulates chronological step-by-step procedure). Example: 烘焙师先称量好那袋面粉的重量，然后往搅拌缸里缓慢注入温水。; Hōngbèishī xiān chēngliáng hǎo nà dài miànfěn de zhòngliàng, ránhòu wǎng jiǎobàngāng lǐ huǎnmàn zhùrù wēnshuǐ.; The baker first weighed that bag of flour accurately, and then slowly poured warm water into the mixing vat.
documents.s: 然后; ránhòu; Then / After that / Afterwards

documents.t: Usage: (因为 + Cause)，所以 + Result (explicitly introduces the resulting consequence in causal constructions). Example: 仓储部未能按时交付核心零配件，所以整个装配车间不得不暂时停工。; Cāngchǔbù wèinéng ànshí jiāofù héxīn língpèijiàn, suǒyǐ zhěnggè zhuāngpèi chējiān bùdébù zànshí tínggōng.; The warehouse department failed to deliver the core spare parts on schedule, so the entire assembly workshop had to suspend work temporarily.
documents.s: 所以; suǒyǐ; Therefore / As a result / So

documents.t: Usage: Context Cause。因此，Resulting Action / Decision (formal objective conclusion marker placed clause-initially). Example: 该沿海城市地下水过度开采，因此市政当局出台了一套严格的限水政策。; Gāi yánhǎi chéngshì dìxiàshuǐ guòdù kāicǎi, yīncǐ shìzhèng dāngjú chūtái le yī tào yángé de xiànshuǐ zhèngcè.; Groundwater in this coastal city was excessively extracted; therefore, the municipal authorities enacted a strict water rationing policy.
documents.s: 因此; yīncǐ; Therefore / For this reason / Thus

documents.t: Usage: Causal Factor，因而 + Organic Outcome (literary coordinator establishing intrinsic causal entailment between two propositions). Example: 那位青年学者提出的崭新假说缺乏确凿的实证支撑，因而遭到了学界的广泛质疑。; Nà wèi qīngnián xuézhě tíchū de zhǎnxīn jiǎshuō quēfá quèzáo de shízhèng zhīchēng, yīn'ér zāodào le xuéjiè de guǎngfàn zhìyí.; The brand-new hypothesis proposed by that young scholar lacked solid empirical support, and thus met with widespread skepticism in academia.
documents.s: 因而; yīn'ér; Therefore / As a result / Thus

documents.t: Usage: 因为 + Objective Cause，(所以) + Consequence (states primary causal etiology; pairs optionally with 所以 / 因此). Example: 因为发动机突发机械故障，机长果断决定将那架客机迫降在备降机场。; Yīnwèi fādòngjī tūfā jīxiè gùzhàng, jīzhǎng guǒduàn juédìng jiāng nà jià kèjī pòjiàng zài bèijiàng jīchǎng.; Because the engine suffered a sudden mechanical failure, the captain decisively resolved to make a forced landing with that airliner at an alternate airport.
documents.s: 因为; yīnwèi; Because / On account of

documents.t: Usage: Clause 1 (Development)，于是 + Clause 2 (Prompt Reactive Measure) (narrative causality marking an immediate subsequent action). Example: 大雾笼罩了整条高速公路，于是交警封锁了各个收费站的入口通道。; Dàwù lǒngzhào le zhěng tiáo gāosù gōnglù, yúshì jiāojǐng fēngsuǒ le gè gè shòufèizhàn de rùkǒu tōngdào.; Heavy fog engulfed the entire expressway, whereupon the traffic police blocked the entrance lanes of every toll booth.
documents.s: 于是; yúshì; Thereupon / Consequently / As a result

documents.t: Usage: 不管 + Variable Condition / Interrogative Pronoun，都 / 也 + Unaltered Outcome (colloquial unconditional marker indicating total invariance). Example: 不管外界舆论如何评价那部电影，这位年轻导演都坚持走实验艺术路线。; Bùguǎn wàijiè yúlùn rúhé píngjià nà bù diànyǐng, zhè wèi niánqīng dǎoyǎn dōu jiānchí zǒu shíyàn yìshù lùxiàn.; No matter how external public opinion evaluates that movie, this young director insists on taking the experimental art path.
documents.s: 不管; bùguǎn; No matter / Regardless of

documents.t: Usage: 除非 + Sole Condition，才 + Outcome or 除非 + Condition，否则 + Failure (isolates an exclusive prerequisite). Example: 除非承租人提前结清欠缴的三个月租金，房东才会退还那笔押金。; Chúfēi chéngzūrén tíqián jiéqīng qiànjiǎo de sān gè yuè zūjīn, fángdōng cái huì tuìhuán nà bǐ yājīn.; Only if the tenant clears the three months of overdue rent in advance will the landlord return that deposit.
documents.s: 除非; chúfēi; Only if / Unless

documents.t: Usage: 无论 + Choice A 还是 Choice B / Wh- Word，都 / 也 + Predicate (formal unconditional marker governing all contingencies). Example: 无论国际金融市场的汇率怎样波动，这家外贸企业的外汇储备规模都保持稳定。; Wúlùn guójì jīnróng shìchǎng de huìlǜ zěnyàng bōdòng, zhè jiā wàimào qǐyè de wàihuì chǔbèi guīmó dōu bǎochí wěndìng.; Regardless of how exchange rates in international financial markets fluctuate, this foreign trade enterprise's foreign exchange reserve volume remains stable.
documents.s: 无论; wúlùn; Regardless of / No matter what

documents.t: Usage: 只要 + Sufficient Condition，就 + Result (identifies an adequate trigger guaranteed to fulfill the main predicate). Example: 只要救援直升机成功空投那箱急救药品，受困伤员的病情就能得到初步缓解。; Zhǐyào jiùyuán zhíshēngjī chénggōng kōngtóu nà xiāng jíjiù yàopǐn, shòukùn shāngyuán de bìngqíng jiù néng dédào chūbù huǎnjiě.; As long as the rescue helicopter successfully air-drops that box of first-aid medication, the stranded casualties' conditions can be initially alleviated.
documents.s: 只要; zhǐyào; As long as / Provided that

documents.t: Usage: 只有 + Indispensable Condition，才 + Outcome (sets a strict necessary requirement without which the result cannot occur). Example: 只有通读了整部古代典籍的注解，学者才能准确破解那些残缺的石刻铭文。; Zhǐyǒu tōngdú le zhěng bù gǔdài diǎnjí de zhùjiě, xuézhě cái néng zhǔnquè pòjiě nàxiē cánquē de shíkè míngwén.; Only by reading through the annotations of the entire ancient classic can the scholar accurately decipher those fragmented stone inscriptions.
documents.s: 只有; zhǐyǒu; Only if / Only when

documents.t: Usage: 即使 + Extreme Hypothesis，也 + Sustained Conclusion (grants a hypothetical worst-case or extreme scenario that leaves the outcome unchanged). Example: 即使对方辩友抛出了极其尖锐的反驳论据，主辩手也丝毫没有慌张。; Jíshǐ duìfāng biànyǒu pāochū le jíqí jiānruì de fǎnbó lùnjù, zhǔbiànshǒu yě sīháo méiyǒu huāngzhāng.; Even if the opposing debater tossed out an extremely incisive counterargument, the lead debater was not flustered in the slightest.
documents.s: 即使; jíshǐ; Even if / Even though

documents.t: Usage: 假如 + Hypothetical Proposition，(就 / 便) + Consequent Action (formal speculative condition marker). Example: 假如这家造船厂无法按期交付那艘万吨货轮，他们将面临巨额违约赔偿。; Jiǎrú zhè jiā zàochuánchǎng wúfǎ ànqī jiāofù nà sōu wàn dūn huòlún, tāmen jiāng miànlín jù'é wéiyuē péicháng.; Supposing this shipyard is unable to deliver that ten-thousand-ton cargo ship on schedule, they will face colossal breach-of-contract indemnities.
documents.s: 假如; jiǎrú; If / Supposing / In case

documents.t: Usage: 哪怕 + Concessive Minimum / Extremity，也 + Unyielding Clause (emphasizes resilient determination against extreme odds). Example: 哪怕只剩下一线微弱的希望，搜救犬训导员也不会放弃在废墟中搜寻幸存者。; Nǎpà zhǐ shèng xià yī xiàn wēiruò de xīwàng, sōujiùquǎn xùndǎoyuán yě bú huì fàngqì zài fèixū zhōng sōuxún xìngcúnzhě.; Even if only a faint thread of hope remains, the search-and-rescue canine trainer will not give up searching for survivors amidst the ruins.
documents.s: 哪怕; nǎpà; Even if / No matter how

documents.t: Usage: 如果 + Hypothetical Condition，(就 / 便) + Result (neutral, standard conditional marker across spoken and written registers). Example: 如果实验室培育出的新品种小麦能够抵御干旱，粮食产量便会大幅递增。; Rúguǒ shíyànshì péiyù chū de xīn pǐnzhǒng xiǎomài nénggòu dǐyù gānhàn, liángshi chǎnliàng biàn huì dàfú dìzēng.; If the new variety of wheat cultivated by the laboratory can withstand drought, grain yield will increase substantially.
documents.s: 如果; rúguǒ; If / In the event of

documents.t: Usage: (以防 / 倘若) + 万一 + Unforeseen Contingency，(就) + Countermeasure (frames low-probability risks or accidental emergencies). Example: 保安队随身携带着防毒面具，以防万一化工厂车间发生有毒气体泄漏事故。; Bǎo'ānduì suíshēn xiédài zhe fángdú miànjù, yǐ fáng wànyī huàgōngchǎng chējiān fāshēng yǒudú qìtǐ xièlòu shìgù.; The security team carried gas masks on them to guard against the unlikely event of a toxic gas leakage accident occurring in the chemical plant workshop.
documents.s: 万一; wànyī; In case / If by any chance

documents.t: Usage: 要是 + Conversational Hypothesis，就 + Result (informal, spoken-register hypothetical marker). Example: 要是今晚航班没有因为雷阵雨延误，我们就能赶上那场精彩的芭蕾舞剧首演。; Yàoshi jīnwǎn hángbān méiyǒu yīnwèi léizhènyǔ yánwù, wǒmen jiù néng gǎn shàng nà chǎng jīngcǎi de bālěiwǔjù shǒuyǎn.; If tonight's flight had not been delayed due to thunderstorms, we would have been able to make it to the premiere of that wonderful ballet drama.
documents.s: 要是; yàoshi; If / In case / Supposing

documents.t: Usage: Preparatory Action，以便 + Facilitated Target Goal (formal purpose conjunction facilitating an intended subsequent operation). Example: 档案馆将所有破损的历史报刊录入了数字化系统，以便研究人员随时检索。; Dàng'ànguǎn jiāng suǒyǒu pòsǔn de lìshǐ bàokān lùrù le shùzìhuà xìtǒng, yǐbiàn yánjiū rényuán suíshí jiǎnsuǒ.; The archives entered all damaged historical newspapers and periodicals into a digital system so that researchers could retrieve them at any time.
documents.s: 以便; yǐbiàn; So that / In order to

documents.t: Usage: Preventive Measure，以免 + Avoided Negative Consequence (formal preventive purpose marker indicating risk deterrence). Example: 搬运工在那台贵重的显微镜外箱上缠绕了数层气泡垫，以免运输途中遭受震裂。; Bānyùngōng zài nà tái guìzhòng de xiǎnwéijìng wàixiāng shang chánrào le shù céng qìpàodiàn, yǐmiǎn yùnshū túzhōng zāoshòu zhènliè.; The movers wrapped several layers of bubble wrap around the outer case of that valuable microscope to avoid shock cracking during transit.
documents.s: 以免; yǐmiǎn; In order to avoid / Lest

documents.t: Usage: Precautionary Action，免得 + Avoided Mishap (colloquial preventive purpose equivalent of 以免). Example: 徒步向导提醒大家随手关好帐篷的防蚊纱网，免得森林里的毒飞虫钻入睡袋。; Túbù xiàngdǎo tíxǐng dàjiā suíshǒu guān hǎo zhàngpeng de fángwén shāwǎng, miǎnde sēnlín lǐ de dú fēichóng zuān rù shuìdài.; The hiking guide reminded everyone to shut the tent's mosquito netting conveniently behind them, lest venomous flying insects from the forest crawl into the sleeping bags.
documents.s: 免得; miǎnde; So as not to / Lest

documents.t: Directional words (方位词) function as locative nouns that attach immediately after reference nouns (Noun + Direction) without prepositions to create locative phrases, or stand independently as subjects, objects, and attributive modifiers (Direction + 的 + Noun).

Usage: Bound postposition attached directly to nouns (Noun + 上) indicating physical surface contact or abstract scope. Example: 那一本词典在这一张桌子上。; Nà yī běn cídiǎn zài zhè yī zhāng zhuōzi shàng.; That dictionary is on this desk.

Usage: Standalone locative noun; interchangeable with 上边 (shàngbiān) and colloquial 上头 (shàngtou). Slots as subject, object, or attributive modifier. Example: 上面那一层货架上摆着三瓶红酒。; Shàngmiàn nà yī céng huòjià shàng bǎizhe sān píng hóngjiǔ.; Three bottles of red wine are arranged on that upper shelf.
documents.s: 上面; shàngmiàn; Top / Above / Surface

documents.t: Usage: Bound postposition affixed directly to nouns (Noun + 下) signifying physical position underneath or an environmental condition. Example: 两只小猫躲在这一棵大树下乘凉。; Liǎng zhī xiǎomāo duǒ zài zhè yī kē dàshù xià chéngliáng.; Two kittens are hiding under this big tree to enjoy the shade.

Usage: Standalone locative noun; interchangeable with 下边 (xiàbiān) and colloquial 下头 (xiàtou). Functions as subject, object, or attributive modifier. Example: 这一把椅子下面放着一只皮箱。; Zhè yī bǎ yǐzi xiàmiàn fàngzhe yī zhī píxiāng.; A leather suitcase is placed underneath this chair.
documents.s: 下面; xiàmiàn; Below / Bottom / Underneath

documents.t: Usage: Bound postposition affixed directly to nouns (Noun + 前) indicating spatial position facing outward or temporal precedence. Example: 门前停着一辆崭新的自行车。; Mén qián tíngzhe yī liàng zhǎnxīn de zìxíngchē.; A brand-new bicycle is parked in front of the door.

Usage: Standalone locative noun; interchangeable with 前边 (qiánbiān) and spoken 前头 (qiántou). Slots as subject, object, or directional modifier. Example: 那一所学校前面有一家大型超市。; Nà yī suǒ xuéxiào qiánmiàn yǒu yī jiā dàxíng chāoshì.; There is a large supermarket in front of that school.
documents.s: 前面; qiánmiàn; In front / Ahead

documents.t: Usage: Bound postposition affixed directly to nouns (Noun + 后) indicating physical position at the rear or temporal succession. Example: 房后有一片郁郁葱葱的竹林。; Fáng hòu yǒu yī piàn yùyùcōngcōng de zhúlín.; There is a lush bamboo grove behind the house.

Usage: Standalone locative noun; interchangeable with 后边 (hòubiān) and colloquial 后头 (hòutou). Functions as subject, object, or modifier. Example: 后面那一辆黑色轿车开得太快了。; Hòumiàn nà yī liàng hēisè jiàochē kāi de tài kuài le.; That black sedan behind is driving too fast.
documents.s: 后面; hòumiàn; Behind / Rear / Back

documents.t: Usage: Independent locative noun; interchangeable with 左面 (zuǒmiàn). Expresses position to the left of a focal reference point (Noun + 左边). Example: 坐在我左边的那一位医生是李大夫。; Zuò zài wǒ zuǒbiān de nà yī wèi yīshēng shì Lǐ dàifu.; The doctor sitting on my left side is Dr. Li.

Usage: Independent locative noun; interchangeable with 右面 (yòumiàn). Expresses position to the right of a focal reference point (Noun + 右边). Example: 那一座红色的邮局就在图书馆右边。; Nà yī zuò hóngsè de yóujú jiù zài túshūguǎn yòubiān.; That red post office is right on the right side of the library.

Usage: Bound postposition attached to common nouns (Noun + 里) to create a locative; never attaches directly to proper geographic country or city names. Example: 这一部手机在她的手提包里。; Zhè yī bù shǒujī zài tā de shǒutíbāo lǐ.; This mobile phone is inside her handbag.

Usage: Standalone locative noun; interchangeable with 里边 (lǐbiān) and colloquial 里头 (lǐtou). Operates independently as subject, object, or modifier. Example: 这一间会议室里面摆着二十把新椅子。; Zhè yī jiān huìyìshì lǐmiàn bǎizhe èrshí bǎ xīn yǐzi.; Twenty new chairs are arranged inside this conference room.

Usage: Bound postposition affixed to nouns (Noun + 外) designating space exterior to an established boundary or limit. Example: 窗外正下着一场倾盆大雨。; Chuāng wài zhèng xiàzhe yī cháng qīngpén dàyǔ.; A torrential downpour is falling outside the window.

Usage: Standalone locative noun; interchangeable with 外边 (wàibiān) and colloquial 外头 (wàitou). Operates as subject, object, or modifier. Example: 外面停着两辆空载的出租车。; Wàimiàn tíngzhe liǎng liàng kōngzài de chūzūchē.; Two vacant taxis are parked outside.

Usage: Locative noun designating the intermediate interval between two coordinates (A 和 B 中间) or the interior center of a defined perimeter. Example: 在两座大厦中间有一条狭窄的小巷。; Zài liǎng zuò dàshà zhōngjiān yǒu yī tiáo xiázhǎi de xiǎoxiàng.; There is a narrow alley between the two skyscrapers.
documents.s: 中间; zhōngjiān; Middle / Between / Center

documents.t: Usage: Locative noun designating immediate lateral adjacency (Noun + 旁边). Example: 那一栋教学楼旁边有一片宽阔的操场。; Nà yī dòng jiàoxuélóu pángbiān yǒu yī piàn kuānkuò de cāochǎng.; Beside that classroom building is an expansive sports field.
documents.s: 旁边; pángbiān; Beside / Side / Next to

documents.t: Usage: Locative noun designating an opposing location facing the reference entity directly across a dividing axis (Noun + 对面). Example: 那一家银行对面新开了一家花店。; Nà yī jiā yínháng duìmiàn xīn kāi le yī jiā huādiàn.; A new flower shop opened across from that bank.
documents.s: 对面; duìmiàn; Opposite / Across from

documents.t: Usage: Directional noun denoting easterly coordinate; interchangeable with 东面 (dōngmiàn). Follows reference nouns or functions as subject/object. Example: 城市东边新建起了一座现代化的体育馆。; Chéngshì dōngbiān xīn jiànqǐ le yī zuò xiàndàihuà de tǐyùguǎn.; A modern stadium was recently built on the east side of the city.
documents.s: 东边; dōngbiān; East side / East

documents.t: Usage: Directional noun denoting westerly coordinate; interchangeable with 西面 (xīmiàn). Follows reference nouns or functions as subject/object. Example: 村庄西边有一条清澈见底的小溪。; Cūnzhuāng xībiān yǒu yī tiáo qīngchè jiàndǐ de xiǎoxī.; There is a crystal-clear stream on the west side of the village.
documents.s: 西边; xībiān; West side / West

documents.t: Usage: Directional noun denoting southerly coordinate; interchangeable with 南面 (nánmiàn). Follows reference nouns or functions as subject/object. Example: 公园南边坐落着一座保存完好的古寺。; Gōngyuán nánbiān zuòluòzhe yī zuò bǎocún wánhǎo de gǔsì.; A well-preserved ancient temple sits on the south side of the park.
documents.s: 南边; nánbiān; South side / South

documents.t: Usage: Directional noun denoting northerly coordinate; interchangeable with 北面 (běimiàn). Follows reference nouns or functions as subject/object. Example: 办公楼北边整齐地停着一排大客车。; Bàngōnglóu běibiān zhěngqí de tíngzhe yī pái dàkèchē.; A row of tour buses is parked neatly on the north side of the office building.
documents.s: 北边; běibiān; North side / North

documents.t: Usage: Locative noun denoting the circumambient boundary or peripheral area encircling a core target (Noun + 周围). Example: 那一座水库周围栽种了数千棵柳树。; Nà yī zuò shuǐkù zhōuwéi zāizhòng le shùqiān kē liǔshù.; Thousands of willow trees are planted around the perimeter of that reservoir.
documents.s: 周围; zhōuwéi; Surroundings / Perimeter / Around

documents.t: Usage: Locative noun denoting the immediate geographic area adjacent to a landmark (Noun + 附近), or functioning independently as a spatial noun. Example: 火车站附近有三家二十四小时营业的药店。; Huǒchēzhàn fùjìn yǒu sān jiā èrshísì xiǎoshí yíngyè de yàodiàn.; There are three 24-hour pharmacies in the vicinity of the railway station.
documents.s: 附近; fùjìn; Vicinity / Nearby area

documents.t: Mandarin prepositions (coverbs) front a prepositional phrase before the main verb to establish the spatial, temporal, instrumental, or relational frame of an action. Unlike English prepositions, many coverbs retain verbal roots and strictly govern word order directly preceding the verb phrase.

Usage: 朝 + Direction / Location / Target + Verb (emphasizes physical orientation or movement heading towards a point). Example: 这列高铁朝终点站疾驰而去。; Zhè liè gāotiě cháo zhōngdiǎnzhàn jíchí ér qù.; This high-speed train speeds towards the terminal station.

Usage: 从 + Spatial Starting Point + Verb / 往 / 到 (marks geographic or physical point of departure). Example: 外交官从那座使馆步行到会议厅。; Wàijiāoguān cóng nà zuò shǐguǎn bùxíng dào huìyìtīng.; The diplomat walked from that embassy to the conference hall.

Usage: Location A + 离 + Location B + Adverb + 远 / 近 / Metric Distance (measures static separation between two reference points). Example: 这家新客栈离风景区只有两公里。; Zhè jiā xīn kèzhàn lí fēngjǐngqū zhǐ yǒu liǎng gōnglǐ.; This new inn is only two kilometers away from the scenic area.
documents.s: 离; lí; Away from / Distant from

documents.t: Usage: 往 + Direction / Target + Action Verb (directs motion along a specific trajectory; commonly pairs with directional monosyllabic verbs). Example: 邮递员骑着一辆摩托车往东拐去。; Yóudìyuán qí zhe yī liàng mótuōchē wǎng dōng guǎi qù.; The courier rode a motorcycle and turned toward the east.
documents.s: 往; wǎng; Toward / In direction of

documents.t: Usage: 向 + Person / Cardinal Direction / Abstract Target + Verb (focuses on intended recipient or purposeful directionality). Example: 记者向那位著名的教授提出了三个疑问。; Jìzhě xiàng nà wèi zhùmíng de jiàoshòu tíchū le sān gè yíwèn.; The reporter posed three questions to that renowned professor.

Usage: 沿 + Route / Perimeter / Waterway / Street + Movement Verb (specifies linear path adherence). Example: 巡逻队沿那条蜿蜒的河流搜寻失踪人员。; Xúnluóduì yán nà tiáo wānyán de héliú sōuxún shīzōng rényuán.; The patrol team searched along that winding river for missing personnel.

Usage: 在 + Physical Location + Action Verb (establishes the locative scene where an action occurs). Example: 建筑师在这间安静的画室里绘制图纸。; Jiànzhùshī zài zhè jiān ānjìng de huàshì lǐ huìzhì túzhǐ.; The architect draws blueprints in this quiet studio.

Usage: 自 + Spatial Origin + Verb (formal/written register equivalent of 从). Example: 这批珍贵的文物自欧洲海运抵达港口。; Zhè pī zhēnguì de wénwù zì Ōuzhōu hǎiyùn dǐdá gǎngkǒu.; This batch of precious cultural relics arrived at the port via sea freight from Europe.

Usage: 趁 + Temporal Window / Opportunity / Fleeting State + Action Verb (acts before conditions change). Example: 工程师打算趁天气晴朗检修那架风力发电机。; Gōngchéngshī dǎsuàn chèn tiānqì qínglǎng jiǎnxiū nà jià fēnglì fādiànjī.; The engineer plans to seize the clear weather to inspect and repair that wind turbine.
documents.s: 趁; chèn; Seizing / Taking advantage of

documents.t: Usage: 从 + Temporal Starting Point + 起 / 开始 / 到... (designates temporal origin). Example: 这间实验室从下周一开始实行封闭管理。; Zhè jiān shíyànshì cóng xià zhōu yī kāishǐ shíxíng fēngbì guǎnlǐ.; This laboratory will implement closed-off management starting next Monday.

Usage: 当 + Event / Temporal Anchor + (的时 / 的时候)，Main Clause (synchronizes primary event with a specific moment). Example: 当警报声响起时，值班医生迅速赶往急诊室。; Dāng jǐngbàoshēng xiǎngqǐ shí, zhíbān yīshēng xùnsù gǎnwǎng jízhěnshì.; When the alarm sounded, the on-duty doctor rushed swiftly to the emergency room.
documents.s: 当; dāng; When / At the time of

documents.t: Usage: 随着 + Evolving Situation / Trend, Main Clause (governs concurrent gradual developments). Example: 随着经济结构优化，这家企业逐步拓展了海外市场。; Suízhe jīngjì jiégòu yōuhuà, zhè jiā qǐyè zhúbù tuòzhǎn le hǎiwài shìchǎng.; Along with the optimization of the economic structure, this enterprise gradually expanded its overseas market.
documents.s: 随着; suízhe; Along with / In the wake of

documents.t: Usage: 在 + Temporal Duration / Period + 期间 / 之中 / 内 (frames action within a bounded period). Example: 代表团在整个访问期间签署了一项合作备忘录。; Dàibiǎotuán zài zhěnggè fǎngwèn qījiān qiānshǔ le yī xiàng hézuò bèiwànglù.; The delegation signed a memorandum of cooperation during the entire visit.
documents.s: 在; zài; In / During (a time frame)

documents.t: Usage: 自 + Historical Point / Date + 以来 / 起 (formal temporal point of inception). Example: 自去年改革以来，该部门的工作效率显著提高。; Zì qùnián gǎigé yǐlái, gāi bùmén de gōngzuò xiàolǜ xiǎnzhù tígāo.; Since last year's reform, this department's work efficiency has improved noticeably.

Usage: 对 + Person / Entity / Issue + Verb / Attitudinal Adjective (marks recipient of attitudes, evaluations, or actions). Example: 导师对这篇论文的论证逻辑感到满意。; Dǎoshī duì zhè piān lùnwén de lùnzhèng luóji gǎndào mǎnyì.; The advisor felt satisfied with the argumentative logic of this thesis.

Usage: 给 + Recipient + Verb or Verb + 给 + Recipient (marks transference recipient or service beneficiary). Example: 前台秘书给那位应聘者递上一杯热茶。; Qiántái mìshū gěi nà wèi yìngpìnzhě dì shang yī bēi rèchá.; The front-desk receptionist handed a cup of hot tea to that applicant.

Usage: 跟 + Interactive Partner + Verb (interactive accompaniment or comparative baseline). Example: 会计师跟那家银行的业务经理核对了账户账目。; Kuàijìshī gēn nà jiā yínháng de yèwù jīnglǐ héduì le zhànghù zhàngmù.; The accountant verified the account entries with that bank's operations manager.

Usage: 和 + Companion + 一起 + Verb (joint participation in an action). Example: 地质学家和考察队员一起攀登了那座险峻的山峰。; Dìzhìxuéjiā hé kǎochá duìyuán yīqǐ pāndēng le nà zuò xiǎnjùn de shānfēng.; The geologist climbed that precipitous mountain peak together with the expedition team members.

Usage: 同 + Diplomatic / Formal Partner + Verb (mid-to-high register coverb for bilateral interactions). Example: 外交部长同外宾就两国经贸合作举行了会谈。; Wàijiāo bùzhǎng tóng wàibīn jiù liǎng guó jīngmào hézuò jǔxíng le huìtán.; The foreign minister held talks with the foreign guests on bilateral economic and trade cooperation.

Usage: 与 + Counterpart + Verb (Formal / Written) (establishes high-register relational binding). Example: 投资方与研发团队签订了一份具有约束力的合同。; Tóuzīfāng yǔ yánfā tuánduì qiāndìng le yī fèn jùyǒu yuēshùlì de hétong.; The investor signed a binding contract with the research and development team.

Usage: 为 + Beneficiary / Client + Verb (indicates intentional service or action done for someone's sake). Example: 社区志愿者为独居老人提供了一项免费理发服务。; Shèqū zhìyuànzhě wèi dújū lǎorén tígōng le yī xiàng miǎnfèi lǐfà fúwù.; Community volunteers provided a free haircut service for solitary seniors.
documents.s: 为; wèi; For / On behalf of

documents.t: Usage: 针对 + Specific Issue / Target Problem + Action Verb (focuses an intervention or countermeasure). Example: 专家组针对城市内涝制定了一套排水改造方案。; Zhuānjiāzǔ zhēnduì chéngshì nèilào zhìdìng le yī tào páishuǐ gǎizào fāng'àn.; The expert panel formulated a drainage renovation plan targeted at urban waterlogging.
documents.s: 针对; zhēnduì; Aimed at / Directed against

documents.t: Usage: 按 + Metric / Sequence / Rate + Verb (governs numerical quotas, chronological order, or fixed rates). Example: 这家诊所按就诊顺序发放预约号牌。; Zhè jiā zhěnsuǒ àn jiùzhěn shùnxù fāfàng yùyuē hàopái.; This clinic issues appointment number plates in accordance with the consultation sequence.

Usage: 按照 + Codified Rules / Blueprints / Mandates + Verb (adherence to established criteria or procedural regulations). Example: 质检员按照操作规程仔细检查了那批机械零件。; Zhìjiǎnyuán ànzhào cāozuò guīchéng zǐxì jiǎnchá le nà pī jīxiè língjiàn.; The quality inspector carefully inspected that batch of mechanical components according to operating procedures.
documents.s: 按照; ànzhào; In accordance with / Following

documents.t: Usage: 根据 + Empirical Evidence / Source Data / Facts, Predicate (cites empirical authority or premise for a conclusion). Example: 气象台根据最新卫星云图发布了暴雨预警信号。; Qìxiàngtái gēnjù zuìxīn wèixīng yúntú fābù le bàoyǔ yùjǐng xìnhào.; The meteorological observatory issued a rainstorm warning signal based on the latest satellite cloud images.
documents.s: 根据; gēnjù; According to / On the basis of

documents.t: Usage: 基于 + Theoretical Premise / Data Foundation (Formal), Main Clause (formal cognitive or analytic foundation). Example: 研究团队基于海量实验数据推导出一项新定理。; Yánjiū tuánduì jīyú hǎiliàng shíyàn shùjù tuīdǎo chū yī xiàng xīn dìnglǐ.; Based on massive experimental data, the research team derived a new theorem.
documents.s: 基于; jīyú; Based on / In light of

documents.t: Usage: 经 + Formal Process / Audit / Deliberation + Outcome (denotes passage through a mandatory procedural phase). Example: 经董事会慎重表决，这项收购决议正式生效。; Jīng dǒngshìhuì shènzhòng biǎojué, zhè xiàng shōugòu juéyì zhèngshì shēngxiào.; After prudent voting by the board of directors, this acquisition resolution took effect officially.

Usage: 据 + Authoritative Source + Reporting Verb / Clause (shortened form of 根据, strictly framing external testimony/reports). Example: 据民航局通报，那架延误的国际航班已安全降落。; Jù mínhángjú tōngbào, nà jià yánwù de guójì hángbān yǐ ānquán jiàngluò.; According to the civil aviation bulletin, that delayed international flight has landed safely.

Usage: 凭 + Credentials / Evidence / Intuition + Action Verb (leverages proof, qualification, or inherent skill). Example: 读者凭借书证可以在这栋图书馆借阅三册典籍。; Dúzhě píng jièshūzhèng kěyǐ zài zhè dòng túshūguǎn jièyuè sān cè diǎnjí.; Readers can borrow three volumes of classic books in this library by virtue of a library card.
documents.s: 凭; píng; By virtue of / Relying on

documents.t: Usage: 通过 + Intermediary / Method / Medium + Goal Achieved (denotes instrument, conduit, or logistical medium). Example: 求职者通过网络招聘渠道投递了一份精心准备的简历。; Qiúzhízhě tōngguò wǎngluò zhàopìn qúdào tóudì le yī fèn jīngxīn zhǔnbèi de jiǎnlì.; The job applicant submitted a meticulously prepared resume through online recruitment channels.
documents.s: 通过; tōngguò; By means of / Through

documents.t: Usage: 以 + Manner / Attitude / Means + Verb (formal coverb governing instrumental or stylistic modality). Example: 辩手以饱满的热情和清晰的语速陈述了自己的观点。; Biànshǒu yǐ bǎomǎn de rèqíng hé qīngxī de yǔsù chénshù le zìjǐ de guāndiǎn.; The debater stated their viewpoint with abundant enthusiasm and a clear speaking pace.
documents.s: 以; yǐ; By means of / Using / On the basis of

documents.t: Usage: 鉴于 + Objective Circumstance / Risk Factor, Resulting Policy / Action (introduces cautionary premise or administrative justification). Example: 鉴于恶劣的暴风雪天气，铁路局取消了那班临客。; Jiànyú èliè de bàofēngxuě tiānqì, tiělùjú qǔxiāo le nà bān línkè.; In view of the severe blizzard weather, the railway bureau canceled that extra passenger train.
documents.s: 鉴于; jiànyú; In view of / Considering that

documents.t: Usage: 为 + Causal Stimulus / Target + (而) + Verb (expresses motivation, cause, or reaction trigger). Example: 全体观众为那位运动员坚韧不拔的毅力热烈鼓掌。; Quántǐ guānzhòng wèi nà wèi yùndòngyuán jiānrèn-bùbá de yìlì rèliè gǔzhǎng.; The entire audience applauded enthusiastically on account of that athlete's tenacious perseverance.

Usage: 为了 + Intended Goal / Future State, Action Clause (expresses intentional forward-looking purpose). Example: 为了缓解早高峰交通拥堵，交警开通了一条潮汐车道。; Wèile huǎnjiě zǎogāofēng jiāotōng yōngdǔ, jiāojǐng kāitōng le yī tiáo cháoxī chēdào.; In order to alleviate morning peak traffic congestion, the traffic police opened a reversible lane.
documents.s: 为了; wèile; In order to / For the purpose of

documents.t: Usage: 由于 + Objective Root Cause, Consequence (states explicit factual cause preceding a result). Example: 由于突发地质灾害，矿区暂停了那处作业面的开采。; Yóuyú tūfā dìzhì zāihài, kuàngqū zàntíng le nà chù zuòyèmiàn de kāicǎi.; Due to a sudden geological disaster, the mining area suspended extraction at that working face.
documents.s: 由于; yóuyú; Due to / Because of

documents.t: Usage: 作为 + Role / Professional Title / Designated Status, Action (frames behavior via specific legal or functional identity). Example: 作为这支研发团队的技术顾问，工程师承担了核心审查职责。; Zuòwéi zhè zhī yánfā tuánduì de jìshù gùwèn, gōngchéngshī chéngdān le héxīn shěnchá zhízé.; As the technical advisor of this R&D team, the engineer assumed the core review responsibilities.
documents.s: 作为; zuòwéi; As / In the capacity of

documents.t: Usage: 除了 + Excluded Item + (以外)，Subject + 都 / 也 / 还 + Verb (delineates exclusion or additive inclusion). Example: 除了两件随身行李以外，旅客不能携带易燃易爆物品登机。; Chúle liǎng jiàn suíshēn xíngli yǐwài, lǚkè bù néng xiédài yìrán-yìbào wùpǐn dēngjī.; Except for two pieces of carry-on luggage, passengers may not carry inflammable or explosive items aboard the plane.
documents.s: 除了; chúle; Except / Besides / Apart from

documents.t: Usage: 对于 + Macro Topic / Policy / Proposed Entity, Viewpoint Clause (isolates an issue as the topical focus of discourse). Example: 对于城市绿化改造方案，市民代表纷纷发表了积极意见。; Duìyú chéngshì lǜhuà gǎizào fāng'àn, shìmín dàibiǎo fēnfēn fābiǎo le jījí yìjiàn.; Regarding the urban greening renovation plan, citizen representatives expressed positive opinions one after another.
documents.s: 对于; duìyú; With regard to / As for

documents.t: Usage: 关于 + Subject Matter + Predicate or 关于 + Subject Matter + 的 + Noun (introduces thematic scope or modifies nominal titles). Example: 学者发表了一篇关于新能源汽车电池回收的学术论文。; Xuézhě fābiǎo le yī piān guānyú xīn-néngyuán qìchē diànchí huíshōu de xuéshù lùnwén.; The scholar published an academic paper concerning the recycling of new energy vehicle batteries.

Usage: 就 + Specific Disputed Item / Agenda + Verb (e.g., 讨论, 交换意见) (narrows discourse strictly to a single targeted point). Example: 双方谈判代表就那项贸易关税纠纷坦诚交换了意见。; Shuāngfāng tánpàn dàibiǎo jiù nà xiàng màoyì guānshuì jiūfēn tǎncéng jiāohuàn le yìjiàn.; Negotiating representatives from both sides candidly exchanged views regarding that trade tariff dispute.
documents.s: 就; jiù; Concerning / With respect to

documents.t: Usage: 连 + Extreme / Baseline Exemplar + 都 / 也 + Predicate (introduces an extreme case to emphasize emphatic scope). Example: 连经验最丰富的资深技师也没能修好那台精密仪器。; Lián jīngyàn zuì fēngfù de zīshēn jìshī yě méi néng xiū hǎo nà tái jīngmì yíqì.; Even the most experienced senior technician could not repair that precision instrument.

Usage: Clause 1; 至于 + Divergent Secondary Topic, Clause 2 (marks an explicit thematic shift to a separate matter). Example: 这笔货款我们已经付清，至于产品运输保险则需要由供货商承担。; Zhè bǐ huòkuǎn wǒmen yǐjīng fùqīng, zhìyú chǎnpǐn yùnshū bǎoxiǎn zé xūyào yóu gōnghuòshāng chéngdān.; We have already cleared this payment for goods; as for product transit insurance, it needs to be borne by the supplier.
documents.s: 至于; zhìyú; As for / Regarding

documents.t: Usage: Verb / Adjective + 于 + Entity / Benchmark (classical marker for location, time, target, or comparative degree). Example: 这种新型复合材料在耐热性能上明显优于传统钢铁。; Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng fùhé cáiliào zài nàirè xìngnéng shang míngxiǎn yōuyú chuántǒng gāngtiě.; This new composite material is distinctly superior to traditional steel in heat-resistant performance.
documents.s: 于; yú; In / At / To / From / Than

documents.t: Usage: Subject + 把 + Definite Object + Action Verb + Resultative / Directional Complement (fronts object to express active disposal and state change). Example: 主厨把那条鲜活的草鱼切成了薄片。; Zhǔchú bǎ nà tiáo xiānhuó de cǎoyú qiē chéng le báopiàn.; The head chef sliced that live grass carp into thin pieces.
documents.s: 把; bǎ; Disposal marker (direct object focus)

documents.t: Usage: Patient + 被 + (Agent) + Verb + Complement / Result (shifts semantic patient to subject position, marking passive endurance). Example: 那份绝密档案被机要员妥善存放在了保险箱内。; Nà fèn juémì dāng'àn bèi jīyàoyuán tuǒshàn cúnfàng zài le bǎoxiǎnxiāng nèi.; That top-secret archive was properly stored in the safe by the confidential clerk.

Usage: Entity A + 比 + Entity B + Adjective + Degree / Numerical Difference (sets structural benchmark for comparative degree). Example: 这套智能灌溉系统比旧设备节省了三成电量。; Zhè tào zhìnéng guàngài xìtǒng bǐ jiù shèbèi jiéshěng le sān chéng diànliàng.; This intelligent irrigation system saves thirty percent more power than the old equipment.

Usage: Patient + 叫 + Specific Agent + Action Verb + Result (spoken passive marker; the agent cannot be omitted). Example: 信封里的聘书叫顽皮的宠物狗撕成了碎片。; Xìnfēng lǐ de pìnshū jiào wánpí de chǒngwùgǒu sī chéng le suìpiàn.; The letter of appointment inside the envelope was torn to shreds by the naughty pet dog.

Usage: Patient + 让 + Specific Agent + Action Verb + Result (spoken passive marker denoting an adverse or unexpected result; agent mandatory). Example: 晒在院子里的被褥让一场突如其来的阵雨淋湿了。; Shài zài yuànzi lǐ de bèirù ràng yī cháng tūrúqílái de zhènyǔ línshī le.; The bedding drying in the courtyard was soaked by a sudden downpour.

Usage: Task / Duty / Obligation + 由 + Designated Agent + Verb (assigns exclusive institutional or personal agency). Example: 这项复杂的文物修复工程由几位经验丰富的老匠人主持。; Zhè xiàng fùzá de wénwù xiūfù gōngchéng yóu jǐ wèi jīngyàn fēngfù de lǎo jiàngrén zhǔchí.; This complex cultural relics restoration project is presided over by several experienced veteran artisans.
documents.s: 由; yóu; Handled by / Due to (agent of responsibility)

documents.t: When followed directly by a location, 在 is the main verb of the sentence. It does not require another verb like "to be" (是 shì). note Subject + 在 (zài) + Location Sentence Form Chinese Pattern Example Affirmative Subj + 在; zài; to be at + Location 我在家; Wǒ zài jiā; I am at home Negative Subj + 不在; bù zài; not at + Location 老师不在办公室。; Lǎoshī bù zài bàngōngshì.; The teacher is not in the office. Question (Where) Subj + 在哪儿; zài nǎr; where? 洗手间在哪儿？; Xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?; Where is the restroom? Yes/No Question Subj + 在; zài; to be at + Location + 吗; ma; question particle 你在家吗？; Nǐ zài jiā ma?; Are you at home? A-not-A Question Subj + 在不在; zài bu zài; at or not at + Location？ 你在不在家？; Nǐ zài bu zài jiā?; Are you at home (or not)? Additional Example with Directional Postposition Yes/No Question: 猫在椅子下面吗？; Māo zài yǐzi xiàmiàn ma?; Is the cat under the chair? A-not-A Question: 猫在不在椅子下面？; Māo zài bu zài yǐzi xiàmiàn?; Is the cat under the chair or not?
documents.s: 1. Main Verb: "To Be Located At / In / On"

documents.t: In English, location usually comes after the action: "I study Chinese in Beijing." In Mandarin, the location sets the stage before the action takes place: note Subject + [在 + Location] + Verb + (Object) English Pattern Chinese Order Example Sentence I eat at home I [at home] eat 我在家吃饭。; Wǒ zài jiā chīfàn.; I eat at home. He studies in Beijing He [in Beijing] studies 他在北京学中文。; Tā zài Běijīng xué Zhōngwén.; He studies Chinese in Beijing. Do you work at a bank? You [at bank] work ma? 你在银行工作吗？; Nǐ zài yínháng gōngzuò ma?; Do you work at a bank? We talk here We [here] talk 我们在这儿聊天。; Wǒmen zài zhèr liáotiān.; We chat here.
documents.s: 2. Preposition / Coverb: Action at a Location

documents.t: When placed immediately before a verb phrase, 在 functions as an aspect marker indicating that an action is currently in progress (equivalent to -ing in English). Sentence Form Chinese Pattern Example Affirmative Subj + 在; zài; in the process of + Verb Phrase 我在看书。; Wǒ zài kànshū.; I am reading a book. Negative Subj + 没在; méi zài; not in the process of / 没有在; méiyǒu zài; not in the process of + Verb Phrase 我没在睡觉。; Wǒ méi zài shuìjiào.; I am not sleeping. Wh-Question Subj + 在做什么？; zài zuò shénme?; what are you doing? 你在做什么？; Nǐ zài zuò shénme?; What are you doing? Yes/No Question Subj + 在; zài; in the process of + Verb Phrase + 吗; ma; question particle 你在打电话吗？; Nǐ zài dǎ diànhuà ma?; Are you making a phone call? A-not-A Question Subj + 在不在; zài bu zài; in the middle of or not + Verb Phrase？ 你在不在看书？; Nǐ zài bu zài kànshū?; Are you reading (or not)? To convey urgency, exact timing, or conversational mood, 在; zài; in the process of can combine with 正; zhèng; just / right now and the modal particle 呢; ne; modal particle indicating ongoing action: Marker Pattern Nuance / Focus Example 在; zài; in the middle of General continuous action ("in the middle of doing") 他在打电话。; Tā zài dǎ diànhuà.; He is making a phone call. 正; zhèng; just at this moment Emphasizes precise timing ("just at this moment") 他正打电话。; Tā zhèng dǎ diànhuà.; He is just making a phone call right now. 正在; zhèngzài; right in the process of Strongest emphasis ("right in the process of") 他正在玩游戏。; Tā zhèngzài wán yóuxì.; He is right in the middle of playing games. 在; zài; in the middle of ... 呢; ne; modal particle indicating ongoing action Casual tone; confirms the ongoing state 他在睡觉呢。; Tā zài shuìjiào ne.; He is sleeping right now. 正在; zhèngzài; right in the process of ... 呢; ne; modal particle indicating ongoing action Maximum emphasis on both timing and state 我正在上课呢。; Wǒ zhèngzài shàngkè ne.; I am right in the middle of class right this second!

In Mandarin, location normally comes before the verb: However, with verbs of posture, placement, residence, or conclusion, 在 (zài) is placed after the verb because the action causes the person or object to end up and remain at that location: note Subject + Verb + 在; zài; at / in / on + Location Verb Verb + 在; zài; at / in / on Example Sentence 住; zhù; to live 住在; zhù zài; to live in / at 我住在北京。; Wǒ zhù zài Běijīng.; I live in Beijing. 放; fàng; to put / place 放在; fàng zài; to put on / in 把手机放在桌上。; Bǎ shǒujī fàng zài zhuō shàng.; Put the phone on the table. 坐; zuò; to sit 坐在; zuò zài; to sit on / in 请坐在那里。; Qǐng zuò zài nàlǐ.; Please sit over there. 站; zhàn; to stand 站在; zhàn zài; to stand at / outside 他站在门外。; Tā zhàn zài mén wài.; He is standing outside the door. 写; xiě; to write 写在; xiě zài; to write on 写在纸上。; Xiě zài zhǐ shàng.; Write it on the paper. 生; shēng; to be born 生在; shēng zài; to be born in 他生在上海。; Tā shēng zài Shànghǎi.; He was born in Shanghai. 停; tíng; to park / stop 停在; tíng zài; to park at 车停在路边。; Chē tíng zài lùbiān.; The car is parked roadside.

In intermediate and advanced Mandarin, 在 pairs with directional words to describe abstract scopes, conditions, and processes rather than physical locations. Framework Scope / Function Example 在; zài; in / at ... 上; shàng; on / aspect Field / Aspect ⤷ "In terms of...", "With respect to..." 在学习上，他很努力。; Zài xuéxí shàng, tā hěn nǔlì.; In terms of his studies, he works very hard. 在; zài; in / at ... 下; xià; under / condition Condition / Influence ⤷ "Under the condition / guidance of..." 在老师的帮助下，他进步很大。; Zài lǎoshī de bāngzhù xià, tā jìnbù hěn dà.; Under the teacher's guidance, he made great progress. 在; zài; in / at ... 中; zhōng; in / during Ongoing Process / Midst ⤷ "In the middle of...", "In the process of..." 新系统正在开发中。; Xīn xìtǒng zhèngzài kāifā zhōng.; The new system is currently in the process of development.

Abstract Type Fixed Expression Domain / Perspective 在工作上; zài gōngzuò shàng; in terms of work Domain / Perspective 在历史上; zài lìshǐ shàng; historically / in history Condition / Circumstance 在这种情况下; zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià; under these circumstances Process / Occurrence 在会议中; zài huìyì zhōng; during / in the meeting Process / Occurrence 在发展中; zài fāzhǎn zhōng; in the course of development

Because 在 serves as both a progressive marker (-ing) and a locative preposition (at/in), you can grammatically have two consecutive instances of 在 in one sentence: note Subject + 在; zài; progressive marker (progressive) + 在; zài; to be located at + Location (locative) + Verb 我在在家里看书。; Wǒ zài zài jiā li kànshū.; I am at home reading. tip While stacking 在 twice is grammatically valid, native speakers usually replace the first 在 with 正在; zhèngzài; right in the process of to avoid repetitive sounds: 我正在家里看书。; Wǒ zhèngzài jiā li kànshū.; I am right at home reading a book. (Much more natural)

In Chinese culture, direct references to death such as 死; sǐ; to die are often considered harsh or taboo in polite conversation. The phrase 不在了; bú zài le; to have passed away (literally "no longer here") functions as a gentle euphemism meaning "to have passed away": 我爷爷已经不在了。; Wǒ yéye yǐjīng bú zài le.; My grandfather has passed away.
documents.s: B. Cultural Euphemism: 不在了; bú zài le; to have passed away

documents.t: note In Mandarin, 是 (shì) functions as an equational verb linking a Noun to another Noun (A = B). It does not link nouns directly to adjectives (use 很 hěn) or locations (use 在 zài). Use 是 to state identity, nationality, profession, or categorical classification: Formula: Subject (Noun / Pronoun) + 是 (shì) + Noun Phrase

Form Pattern Example Sentence Affirmative Subj + 是 + Noun 我是中国人。 Wǒ shì Zhōngguórén. ⤷ I am Chinese. Negative Subj + 不是 + Noun 他不是医生。 Tā bú shì yīshēng. ⤷ He is not a doctor. Question (吗) Subj + 是 + Noun + 吗？ 你是学生吗？ Nǐ shì xuésheng ma? ⤷ Are you a student? Question (A-not-A) Subj + 是不是 + Noun？ 他是不是你哥哥？ Tā shì bu shì nǐ gēge? ⤷ Is he your older brother?
While you cannot say 我是高兴 (I am happy), there are two specific structures where 是 pairs with adjectives:
documents.s: 2. When CAN 是 Be Used with Adjectives?

documents.t: When an adjective describes a permanent quality, category, color, or material, attach 的 (de) to nominalize the adjective: Formula: Subject + 是 + Adjective + 的 这个苹果是红的。 Zhè ge píngguǒ shì hóng de. ⤷ This apple is a red one. 这辆车是新的。 Zhè liàng chē shì xīn de. ⤷ This car is a new one. 这把雨伞是黑色的。 Zhè bǎ yǔsǎn shì hēisè de. ⤷ This umbrella is black.
documents.s: A. The 是……的 Pattern (Category & Inherent Properties)

documents.t: When you want to emphatically confirm a statement or counter someone's doubt, stress the word 是: A: 今天不冷吧？ (It's not cold today, right?) B: 今天天气是冷！ Jīntiān tiānqì shì lěng! ⤷ Today's weather is indeed cold!
documents.s: B. Emphatic Confirmation ("It IS true that...")

documents.t: When an event has already occurred, 是 pairs with 的 to highlight a specific known detail: when, where, how, or by whom the action took place. Formula: Subject + 是 (shì) + [Emphasized Detail] + Verb + 的 (de) Emphasized Detail Focus Example Sentence Time When it happened 我是昨天来的。 Wǒ shì zuótiān lái de. ⤷ I arrived yesterday. Place Where it happened 我们是在上海认识的。 Wǒmen shì zài Shànghǎi rènshi de. ⤷ It was in Shanghai that we met. Manner / Means How it was done 他是坐火车去的。 Tā shì zuò huǒchē qù de. ⤷ He went by train. Agent Who performed it 这本书是他写的。 Zhè běn shū shì tā xiě de. ⤷ This book was written by him.
documents.s: 3. The 是……的 (shì... de) Construction: Emphasizing Past Details

documents.t: To acknowledge a point or drawback before presenting a contrasting reality, repeat the adjective or verb around 是: Formula: [Adjective / Verb] + 是 + [Adjective / Verb]，但是…… (dànshì...) 贵是贵，但是很好用。 Guì shì guì, dànshì hěn hǎoyòng. ⤷ It is expensive, but it works really well. 去是去，但是我不想待太久。 Qù shì qù, dànshì wǒ bù xiǎng dāi tài jiǔ. ⤷ I will go, but I don't want to stay too long.
documents.s: 4. Concessive 是: "It is X, but..." (是……但是……)

documents.t: Mandarin has no universal word for "yes". However, when a question confirms identity or asks with 是, respond using: Response Usage / Tone Example 是 Direct affirmation 是。 Shì. ⤷ Yes / That is correct. 是的 Polite / conversational confirmation 是的。 Shìde. ⤷ Yes, that's right. 不是 Direct denial 不是。 Bú shì. ⤷ No / That's not correct.

In possession sentences, 有 directly links the possessor (subject) to the object owned. warning The Golden Rule: Never Say "不有" In Mandarin, virtually all verbs are negated with 不 (bù). 有 is the absolute exception. You must always negate 有 with 没 (méi) or 没有 (méiyǒu). ❌ 我不有钱 (Incorrect) ✔️ 我没有钱 (Correct)

Sentence Form Chinese Pattern Example Sentence Affirmative Subj + 有 + Object 我有一只猫。; Wǒ yǒu yì zhī māo.; I have a cat. 我们有时间。; Wǒmen yǒu shíjiān.; We have time. Negative Subj + 没有 / 没 + Object 我没有钱。; Wǒ méiyǒu qián.; I don't have money. 他没车。; Tā méi chē.; He doesn't have a car (colloquial short form). Question (吗) Subj + 有 + Object + 吗？ 你有铅笔吗？; Nǐ yǒu qiānbǐ ma?; Do you have a pencil? Question (A-not-A) Subj + 有没有 + Object？ 你有没有铅笔？; Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu qiānbǐ?; Do you have a pencil (or not)?

English uses the dummy subject "there", but Mandarin has no dummy pronouns. Instead, the location itself serves as the subject, followed by 有: Formula: Location / Place + 有 (yǒu) + Object Location Type Example Sentence On a Surface 桌子上有一本书。; Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn shū.; There is a book on the table. Inside a Place 学校里有很多学生。; Xuéxiào lǐ yǒu hěn duō xuésheng.; There are many students in the school. Spatial Direction 前面有一家咖啡馆。; Qiánmiàn yǒu yì jiā kāfēiguǎn.; There is a coffee shop up ahead.

Verb Pattern Information Focus Example Sentence 有 (Existence) Location + 有 + Item What is at the place (new item) 桌上有手机。; Zhuō shàng yǒu shǒujī.; There is a phone on the table. 在 (Location) Item + 在 + Location Where a known item is (new location) 手机在桌上。; Shǒujī zài zhuō shàng.; The phone is on the table.

Both 有的 (yǒude) and 有些 (yǒuxiē) express "some", but they differ in sentence structure, nuance, and part of speech: Feature 有的 (yǒude) 有些 (yǒuxiē) Core Meaning "Certain ones / some (out of a defined group)" "Some / a few (indefinite quantity)" Paired Pattern Standard for 有的……有的…… (some..., others...) Possible (有些……有些……), but less common Standalone Subject ✔️ Can stand completely alone without a noun ⚠️ Prefers pairing with a noun (e.g., 有些人) Modifying Adjectives ❌ Never (Cannot mean "somewhat") ✔️ Yes (Synonymous with 有点儿, meaning "a bit / somewhat")
documents.s: 3. Partitives & Subsets: 有的 vs. 有些

documents.t: When contrasting different members of a group performing distinct actions, 有的……，有的…… is the standard, preferred choice. It can stand alone as a pronoun without repeating the noun: Formula: (Subject Group) + 有的 + Predicate 1，有的 + Predicate 2 我们班的学生，有的喜欢看书，有的喜欢运动。; Wǒmen bān de xuésheng, yǒude xǐhuan kànshū, yǒude xǐhuan yùndòng.; In our class, some students like reading, and others like sports. 有的人想去，有的人不想去。; Yǒude rén xiǎng qù, yǒude rén bù xiǎng qù.; Some people want to go, while others do not.

When modifying nouns, both are grammatically correct, but the nuance shifts: 有的 (yǒude) emphasizes a partitive selection from a specific whole ("certain ones among them"): 有的问题很难。; Yǒude wèntí hěn nán.; Certain questions are very difficult. 有些 (yǒuxiē) contains the plural measure word 些 (xiē), emphasizing an indefinite quantity ("a few / some amount"): 有些人喜欢喝茶。; Yǒuxiē rén xǐhuan hē chá.; Some people like drinking tea.

This is the most critical grammatical difference: caution Critical Distinction: Modifying Adjectives 有些 can function as an adverb of degree meaning "somewhat / a little bit", exactly like 有点(儿). 有的 can NEVER modify an adjective directly. ✔️ 我今天有些累。; Wǒ jīntiān yǒuxiē lèi.; I am a bit tired today. ❌ 我今天有的累。 (Completely ungrammatical)

When paired with an adjective or psychological verb, 有点儿 (yǒudiǎnr) (or southern 有点 / 有一点) acts as an adverb meaning "a little bit" or "kind of". 有点(儿) almost always expresses a negative, undesirable, or complaining nuance (too cold, too tired, too expensive). Formula: Subject + 有点(儿) + Adjective / Verb 我今天有点儿累。; Wǒ jīntiān yǒudiǎnr lèi.; I am a bit tired today. 这件衣服有点儿贵。; Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒudiǎnr guì.; This piece of clothing is a bit expensive. 这个汉字有点儿难。; Zhè ge hànzì yǒudiǎnr nán.; This Chinese character is a bit difficult. tip Pitfall: 有点儿 vs. 一点儿 有点儿 + Adj comes before the adjective and means "a bit too [unfavorable trait]": 今天有点儿冷。; Jīntiān yǒudiǎnr lěng.; Today is a bit chilly. Adj + 一点儿 comes after the adjective and expresses a comparison or request ("a little more..."): 请慢一点儿。; Qǐng màn yìdiǎnr.; Please be a little slower.
documents.s: 4. Degree Adverb: 有点(儿) (A Bit / Somewhat)

documents.t: 有 and 没有 evaluate whether something reaches a certain benchmark or standard: Comparison Type Pattern Example Sentence Negative Comparison ⤷ "A is not as [adj] as B" A + 没有 + B + (那么) + Adj 今天没有昨天冷。; Jīntiān méiyǒu zuótiān lěng.; Today is not as cold as yesterday. 他没有我高。; Tā méiyǒu wǒ gāo.; He is not as tall as me. 中文没有你想象的那么难。; Zhōngwén méiyǒu nǐ xiǎngxiàng de nàme nán.; Chinese is not as hard as you imagine. Question Benchmark ⤷ "Is A as [adj] as B?" A + 有 + B + (那么) + Adj + 吗？ 你有他那么高吗？; Nǐ yǒu tā nàme gāo ma?; Are you as tall as him?

In Chinese, compound adjectives and expressions are formed by pairing nouns with 有 (possessing) or 没 (lacking): Positive ([有 yǒu]) Negative ([没 méi]) 有用; yǒuyòng; Useful 没用; méiyòng; Useless 有意思; yǒuyìsi; Interesting / Fun 没意思; méiyìsi; Boring / Pointless 有钱; yǒuqián; Rich / Wealthy 没钱; méiqián; Broke / Has no money 有空; yǒukòng; To have free time 没空; méikòng; Busy / No free time 有礼貌; yǒulǐmào; Polite (has manners) 没礼貌; méilǐmào; Rude / Impolite 有名; yǒumíng; Famous (has a name) — 有时候; yǒushíhou; Sometimes — tip When knocking on a public restroom stall door, stepping into a quiet shop, or checking if a seat is taken: 有人吗？; Yǒu rén ma?; Is anyone here? / Is this occupied?
documents.s: 2. High-Frequency Vocabulary Built with 有 vs. 没

documents.t: 💡 How to Use Colors with Nouns: Formal / Descriptive: Color + 色的 + Noun ➡️ 红色的衣服 (hóngsè de yīfu — red clothes) Compound / Direct: Drop the 色 and 的 for simple fixed collocations ➡️ 红茶 (hóngchá — black tea), 蓝天 (lántiān — blue sky) Color Cultural & Usage Notes High-Frequency Examples & Idioms 红色; hóngsè; Red Luck, joy, and prosperity. Worn at weddings, Chinese New Year, and birthdays of the elderly. • 红包 (hóngbāo) — red envelope / gift money • 大红大紫 (dà hóng dà zǐ) — wildly popular / successful • 红茶 (hóngchá) — black tea (lit. "red tea") 蓝色; lánsè; Blue Calmness, sky, ocean, and trust. Widely used in corporate logos and technology contexts. • 蓝天白云 (lántiān báiyún) — blue sky and white clouds • 蓝色海洋 (lánsè hǎiyáng) — blue ocean 黄色; huángsè; Yellow Royalty and imperial power in ancient China. ⚠️ Modern Slang: Refers to erotic, NSFW, or adult content. • 黄金 (huángjīn) — gold / imperial wealth • 黄色电影 (huángsè diànyǐng) — adult / rated-R film • 扫黄 (sǎo huáng) — anti-pornography crackdown 绿色; lǜsè; Green Nature, health, and eco-friendliness. ⚠️ Cultural Taboo: Never give or wear a green hat! • 绿色食品 (lǜsè shípǐn) — organic / eco-friendly food • 戴绿帽子 (dài lǜ màozi) — to be cheated on by one's partner (taboo) • 绿茶 (lǜchá) — green tea 黑色; hēisè; Black Formality, mystery, and seriousness. Associated with the underground, secrecy, or illegal activity. • 黑马 (hēimǎ) — dark horse (unexpected winner) • 黑社会 (hēishèhuì) — mafia / criminal underworld • 黑色幽默 (hēisè yōumò) — dark humor 白色; báisè; White Purity and innocence. ⚠️ Traditionally the color of mourning and funerals (白事). • 白开水 (báikāishuǐ) — plain boiled water • 白白浪费 (báibái làngfèi) — waste in vain ("white" can mean doing something with no result) 橙色; chéngsè; Orange Vitality, cheerfulness, and warmth. Frequently used for public transit lines and safety alerts. • 橙汁 (chéngzhī) — orange juice • 橙色预警 (chéngsè yùjǐng) — orange alert (second-highest weather warning) 紫色; zǐsè; Purple Nobility, elegance, and mystique. Historically associated with the emperor and divine favor. • 紫禁城 (Zǐjìnchéng) — Forbidden City (lit. "Purple Forbidden City") • 紫气东来 (zǐ qì dōng lái) — purple air comes from the east (propitious omen) 粉色; fěnsè; Pink Youth, romance, sweetness, and cuteness. Often used in love, spring blossoms, and lifestyle branding. • 粉色连衣裙 (fěnsè liányīqún) — pink dress • 粉红色的回忆 (fěnhóngsè de huíyì) — fond, sweet romantic memories 灰色; huīsè; Gray Neutrality, minimalism, and modesty. Also associated with gloominess or moral/legal ambiguity. • 灰色地带 (huīsè dìdài) — gray area (neither strictly legal nor illegal) • 灰心 (huīxīn) — discouraged / lose heart 青色; qīngsè; Cyan / Teal / Grue Nature, vitality, and historical mystery. One of the traditional "Five Elements" colors (associated with Wood, Spring, and the East). Depending on the noun, it can mean green, blue, or black. • 青年 (qīngnián) — youth / young person • 青山绿水 (qīngshān lǜshuǐ) — green hills and clear waters • 青天 (qīngtiān) — clear blue sky (also refers to an upright official) • 青出于蓝 (qīng chū yú lán) — the student surpasses the master

The greatest relief in learning Mandarin is that Chinese verbs never conjugate: No past, present, or future verb inflections (no "eat / ate / eaten"). No agreement with pronouns (no "I do / he does"). The verb 吃 (chī) remains 吃 in all contexts. Basic Sentence Structure: Subject + Verb + Object (SVO)

documents.t: Like telling time, dates in Mandarin follow the universal Chinese rule: Largest Unit ➔ Smallest Unit: 年; nián; Year ➔ 月; yuè; Month ➔ 日; rì; Day (written) / 号; hào; Day (spoken) ➔ 星期; xīngqī; Day of week Example: 2026年9月1日星期二; èr líng èr liù nián, jiǔ yuè yī rì, xīngqī'èr; Tuesday, September 1, 2026 (Literal order: Year 2026, September, 1st Day, Tuesday)

⚠️ The Year Trap: In English, we say "twenty twenty-six" or "two thousand twenty-six". In Mandarin, years are simply read digit-by-digit + 年; nián; Year. Never read years as thousands! Year Spoken Breakdown 一九九八年; yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián; Year 1998 1 + 9 + 9 + 8 + 年 二零零八年; èr líng líng bā nián; Year 2008 2 + 0 + 0 + 8 + 年 二零二五年; èr líng èr wǔ nián; Year 2025 2 + 0 + 2 + 5 + 年 今年; jīnnián; This year Base vocabulary

documents.t: Days of the week are constructed as [Term] + [Number 1–6]. Sunday is the only irregular day—never say "星期七"! In formal writing and broadcasting, 星期日; xīngqīrì; Sunday or 周日; zhōurì; Sunday is preferred).

💡 The Spatial Mental Model: Weeks & Months follow a vertical calendar: the past is "above" (上; shàng; Above / Previous), the future is "below" (下; xià; Below / Next). Days & Years follow a horizontal timeline: the past is "front / before" (前; qián; Before / Ago), the future is "behind / after" (后; hòu; After / Later). Time Frame Days (天; tiān; Day) Weeks (星期; xīngqī; Week) Months (月; yuè; Month) Years (年; nián; Year) -2 Cycles 前天; qiántiān; Day before yesterday 上上个星期; shàngshàng ge xīngqī; 2 weeks ago 上上个月; shàngshàng ge yuè; 2 months ago 前年; qiánnián; Year before last -1 Cycle 昨天; zuótiān; Yesterday 上个星期; shàng ge xīngqī; Last week 上个月; shàng ge yuè; Last month 去年; qùnián; Last year ⚠️ Present 今天; jīntiān; Today 这个星期; zhè ge xīngqī; This week 这个月; zhè ge yuè; This month 今年; jīnnián; This year +1 Cycle 明天; míngtiān; Tomorrow 下个星期; xià ge xīngqī; Next week 下个月; xià ge yuè; Next month 明年; míngnián; Next year +2 Cycles 后天; hòutiān; Day after tomorrow 下下个星期; xiàxià ge xīngqī; 2 weeks from now 下下个月; xiàxià ge yuè; 2 months from now 后年; hòunián; Year after next

documents.t: You do not stack words infinitely (avoid saying "上上上个星期"). Instead, use these two systematic patterns: 1. The "大" (dà) Extension for Exactly ±3 Cycles (Days & Years Only)​ Time Frame Days (天; tiān; Day) Years (年; nián; Year) -3 Cycles (3 units ago) 大前天; dàqiántiān; 3 days ago 大前年; dàqiánnián; 3 years ago +3 Cycles (3 units later) 大后天; dàhòutiān; 3 days from now 大后年; dàhòunián; 3 years from now (大; dà; Big / Great is not used for weeks or months). 2. The Universal Mathematical Formula (3+ Cycles & General Time)​ Past (Ago): [Number] + Unit + [前; qián; Ago / Before](qian2.wav) Future (Later): [Number] + Unit + [后; hòu; Later / After](hou4.wav) Time Unit Past: [#] + Unit + 前 Future: [#] + Unit + 后 Days 三天前; sān tiān qián; 3 days ago 五天后; wǔ tiān hòu; 5 days from now Weeks 三个星期前; sān gè xīngqī qián; 3 weeks ago 两周后; liǎng zhōu hòu; 2 weeks later Months 四个月前; sì gè yuè qián; 4 months ago 六个月后; liù gè yuè hòu; 6 months later Years 十年前; shí nián qián; 10 years ago 三年后; sān nián hòu; 3 years later
